entries.description: Conditions manipulation video prediction on structured action trees and depth-semantic guidance for instruction-following control.

entries.name: Towards Suturing World Models
entries.fullTitle: Towards Suturing World Models: Learning Predictive Models for Robotic Surgical Tasks
entries.description: Trains diffusion predictors of fine-grained surgical suturing actions as a basis for controllable surgical simulation and evaluation.

entries.name: Surgical Vision World Model
entries.fullTitle: Surgical Vision World Model
entries.description: Learns latent actions from unlabeled surgical videos to generate controllable surgical rollouts.

entries.name: Multi-Stage Manipulation with Demonstration-Augmented Reward, Policy, and World Model Learning
entries.fullTitle: Multi-Stage Manipulation with Demonstration-Augmented Reward, Policy, and World Model Learning
entries.description: Combines demonstration-augmented rewards, policies, and visual dynamics for sparse-reward multi-stage manipulation.

entries.name: RoboHorizon
entries.fullTitle: RoboHorizon: An LLM-Assisted Multi-View World Model for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Combines language-derived dense rewards and multi-view predictive representations for long-horizon robotic manipulation.

entries.name: Representing Positional Information in Generative World Models for Object Manipulation
entries.fullTitle: Representing Positional Information in Generative World Models for Object Manipulation
entries.description: Studies positional and object-centric latent goal conditioning to improve world-model-based object manipulation.

entries.name: Factored World Models for Zero-Shot Generalization in Robotic Manipulation
entries.fullTitle: Factored World Models for Zero-Shot Generalization in Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Models continuous robot actions with object-factored graph dynamics and plans pick-and-place sequences that generalize to new object arrangements.

entries.name: FeelWorld
entries.fullTitle: FeelWorld: Visuo-Tactile World Model for Hierarchical Contact Prediction and Planning
entries.description: Hierarchical visuo-tactile world model that jointly predicts visual latents, contact states, force-related tactile latents, and slip states. Its imagined futures support contact-aware CEM planning for grasping and insertion.

entries.name: Robot-Factored World Models
entries.fullTitle: Robot-Factored World Models via Robot Rendering
entries.description: Factors robot-specific action realization, geometry, kinematics, and appearance out of the learned world model through controller rollouts and URDF-based robot rendering, improving cross-view and cross-embodiment manipulation prediction.

entries.name: ViTacWorld
entries.fullTitle: ViTacWorld: Scaling Visuo-Tactile World Models for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
entries.description: Action-conditioned visuo-tactile world model that predicts aligned visual observations and tactile feedback. It generates synthetic manipulation rollouts for policy training and evaluates policies through predicted contact-rich outcomes.

entries.name: Robotic Ultrasound World Model
entries.fullTitle: Action-Conditioned World Model for Goal Plane Probe Guidance in Robotic Ultrasound
entries.description: Uses a latent conditional diffusion world model to predict future ultrasound observations from context frames and probe motions, then trains a goal-conditioned temporal transformer with rewards supplied by the frozen world model.

entries.name: PhysCoRe
entries.fullTitle: PhysCoRe: Physics-Corrected Residual World Models for Material-Aware Deformable Dynamics
entries.description: Couples a differentiable Material Point Method simulator with learned material-refinement and residual-correction modules, enabling material-aware prediction and online identification for deformable-object manipulation.

entries.name: DriftWorld
entries.fullTitle: DriftWorld: Fast World Modeling through Drifting
entries.description: Replaces iterative diffusion rollouts with a fast drifting formulation for action-conditioned robot world modeling, supporting real-time future prediction, planning, and offline policy ranking.

entries.name: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0
entries.fullTitle: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0: Unified Embodied Synthesis with World Foundation Model
entries.description: A unified embodied world foundation model spanning scene synthesis, embodied video generation, cross-embodiment transfer, and multi-view physical-world generation for robot learning.

entries.name: UniSim
entries.fullTitle: Learning Interactive Real-World Simulators
entries.description: Universal neural simulator of real-world physics; trained on diverse action-conditioned data to generalize across robot morphologies.

entries.name: IRASim
entries.fullTitle: IRASim: A Fine-Grained World Model for Robot Manipulation
entries.description: Uses frame-level action conditioning in a diffusion transformer to simulate robot manipulation, supporting policy evaluation, model-based planning and interactive control.

entries.name: RoboDreamer
entries.fullTitle: RoboDreamer: Learning Compositional World Models for Robot Imagination

entries.name: AVID
entries.fullTitle: AVID: Adapting Video Diffusion Models to World Models
entries.description: Adapts pretrained video diffusion models into action-conditioned world models for both games and real-world robotics when action-labeled data is scarce.

entries.name: DreamDojo
entries.fullTitle: DreamDojo: A Generalist Robot World Model from Large-Scale Human Videos
entries.description: A large-scale robot world model explicitly targeting generalist transfer from human videos.

entries.name: PlayWorld
entries.fullTitle: PlayWorld: Learning Robot World Models from Autonomous Play
entries.description: Stands out for learning a robot world model from unsupervised autonomous play rather than success-biased demonstrations.

entries.name: DexWorldModel
entries.fullTitle: DexWorldModel: Causal Latent World Modeling towards Automated Learning of Embodied Tasks
entries.description: Targets dexterous embodied learning with a more explicitly causal latent dynamics design.

entries.name: IRL-VLA
entries.fullTitle: IRL-VLA: Training an Vision-Language-Action Policy via Reward World Model

entries.name: Mask World Model
entries.fullTitle: Mask World Model: Predicting What Matters for Robust Robot Policy Learning
entries.description: Focuses robot world modeling on task-relevant prediction targets rather than pixel-complete reconstruction.

entries.name: Hi-WM
entries.fullTitle: Hi-WM: Human-in-the-World-Model for Scalable Robot Post-Training
entries.description: Connects human feedback and world-model rollouts for scalable robot post-training.

entries.name: EnerVerse
entries.fullTitle: EnerVerse: Envisioning Embodied Future Space for Robotics Manipulation
entries.description: Generative robotics foundation model (AgiBot) using chunk-wise autoregressive video diffusion + 4D Gaussian splatting data engine; enables robotic policy via the EnerVerse-A policy head.

entries.name: EnerVerse-AC
entries.fullTitle: EnerVerse-AC: Envisioning Embodied Environments with Action Condition
entries.description: Action-conditioned extension of EnerVerse; multi-level action conditioning + multi-view generation for robot policy testing without physical robots.

entries.name: Genie Envisioner
entries.fullTitle: Genie Envisioner: A Unified World Foundation Platform for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Unified manipulation platform that combines world-model imagination, evaluation, and robot data generation.

entries.name: OSCAR
entries.fullTitle: OSCAR: Omni-Embodiment Action-Conditioned World Model for Robotics
entries.description: Action-conditioned robot video world model that uses kinematic skeleton conditioning to generalize policy evaluation across robot embodiments.

entries.name: IOI
entries.fullTitle: IOI: Decoupling Kinematics and Physics for Interactive World Models
entries.description: Hybrid interactive robot world model that injects analytical kinematic priors into video generation, improving control alignment, OOD generalization, policy evaluation, and real-world data synthesis.

entries.name: RynnWorld-4D
entries.fullTitle: RynnWorld-4D: 4D Embodied World Models for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Jointly predicts RGB, depth, and optical flow, then exposes the learned 4D representation to a closed-loop policy for dexterous manipulation.

entries.name: RynnWorld-Teleop
entries.fullTitle: RynnWorld-Teleop: An Action-Conditioned World Model for Digital Teleoperation
entries.description: Turns hand-pose streams into embodiment-agnostic action-conditioned robot videos, enabling real-time digital teleoperation and scalable imitation data generation.

entries.name: SurgVista
entries.fullTitle: SurgVista: Long-Horizon Surgical World Modeling with Plausible Instrument-Tissue Dynamics
entries.description: Action-conditioned surgical world model targeting spatially coherent instrument-tissue deformation and stable long-horizon rollouts.

entries.name: TouchWorld
entries.fullTitle: TouchWorld: A Predictive and Reactive Tactile Foundation Model for Dexterous Manipulation
entries.description: Treats tactile signals as both predictive contact references and fast feedback, combining tactile world-model prediction with visuo-tactile action generation and residual correction.

entries.name: Mask2Real-WM
entries.fullTitle: Mask2Real-WM: Segmentation Masks as a Sim-to-Real Bridge for Controllable Dexterous World Models
entries.description: Separates dynamics prediction in segmentation space from photorealistic rendering, reducing the sim-to-real gap for fine-grained dexterous control.

entries.name: WoW
entries.fullTitle: WoW: Towards a World omniscient World model Through Embodied Interaction
entries.description: Large embodied-interaction world model that targets broad scene and object dynamics through active interaction.

entries.name: PointWorld
entries.fullTitle: PointWorld: Scaling 3D World Models for In-The-Wild Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Pretrained 3D world model that represents robot actions as 3D point flows for cross-embodiment manipulation.

entries.name: DexWM
entries.fullTitle: World Models for Learning Dexterous Hand-Object Interactions from Human Videos
entries.description: Learns dexterous hand-object interaction dynamics from human videos via keypoint-conditioned latent prediction.

entries.name: FLARE
entries.fullTitle: FLARE: Robot Learning with Implicit World Modeling
entries.description: Uses implicit world modeling to improve robot learning without requiring a full explicit pixel simulator.

entries.name: AgiBot World Colosseo
entries.fullTitle: AgiBot World Colosseo: A Large-scale Manipulation Platform for Scalable and Intelligent Embodied Systems
entries.description: Large-scale manipulation platform and dataset resource supporting embodied world-model training and evaluation.

entries.name: DreamGen
entries.fullTitle: DreamGen: Unlocking Generalization in Robot Learning through Video World Models
entries.description: Uses video world models to synthesize robot experience and improve policy generalization.

entries.name: WEAVER
entries.fullTitle: WEAVER, Better, Faster, Longer: An Effective World Model for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Multi-view latent robot world model built for policy evaluation, policy improvement, and test-time planning with faster long-horizon rollouts.

entries.name: WVM
entries.fullTitle: World Value Models for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Marries world-model temporal prediction with value estimation, introducing Suboptimal-Value-Bench for learning from mixed-quality manipulation trajectories.

entries.name: Primitive World Models
entries.fullTitle: Learning Primitive Embodied World Models: Towards Scalable Robotic Learning
entries.description: Decomposes embodied prediction into primitive-level world-model units for scalable robot learning.

entries.name: GWM
entries.fullTitle: GWM: Towards Scalable Gaussian World Models for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Uses Gaussian scene representations as a scalable manipulation world model.

entries.name: ORV
entries.fullTitle: ORV: 4D Occupancy-centric Robot Video Generation
entries.description: Brings 4D occupancy structure into robot video generation for more spatially grounded prediction.

entries.name: LaDi-WM
entries.fullTitle: LaDi-WM: A Latent Diffusion-based World Model for Predictive Manipulation
entries.description: Latent diffusion world model for predictive robot manipulation.

entries.name: AdaWorld
entries.fullTitle: AdaWorld: Learning Adaptable World Models with Latent Actions
entries.description: Learns latent actions that make the world model adaptable across tasks and embodiments.

entries.name: DyWA
entries.fullTitle: DyWA: Dynamics-adaptive World Action Model for Generalizable Non-prehensile Manipulation
entries.description: Dynamics-adaptive WAM for contact-rich, non-prehensile manipulation.

entries.name: KeyWorld
entries.fullTitle: KeyWorld: Key Frame Reasoning Enables Effective and Efficient World Models
entries.description: Uses key-frame reasoning to reduce manipulation rollout cost while keeping action-relevant futures.

entries.name: SAMPO
entries.fullTitle: SAMPO: Scale-wise Autoregression with Motion Prompt for Generative World Models
entries.description: Adds scale-wise autoregression and motion prompts for controllable generative world modeling.

entries.name: 3DFlowAction
entries.fullTitle: 3DFlowAction: Learning Cross-Embodiment Manipulation from 3D Flow World Model
entries.description: Uses 3D flow world modeling as a cross-embodiment manipulation interface.

entries.name: WoMAP
entries.fullTitle: WoMAP: World Models For Embodied Open-Vocabulary Object Localization
entries.description: Applies embodied world modeling to open-vocabulary object localization.

entries.name: OSVI-WM
entries.fullTitle: OSVI-WM: One-Shot Visual Imitation for Unseen Tasks using World-Model-Guided Trajectory Generation
entries.description: Uses world-model-guided trajectory generation for one-shot imitation on unseen tasks.

entries.name: LUMOS
entries.fullTitle: LUMOS: Language-Conditioned Imitation Learning with World Models
entries.description: Language-conditioned imitation learning with a predictive world-model component.

entries.name: Object-Centric World Model
entries.fullTitle: Object-Centric World Model for Language-Guided Manipulation
entries.description: Object-centric state abstraction for language-guided manipulation planning.

entries.name: WHALE
entries.fullTitle: WHALE: Towards Generalizable and Scalable World Models for Embodied Decision-making
entries.description: Scalable embodied world model aimed at generalizable decision making.

entries.name: VisualPredicator
entries.fullTitle: VisualPredicator: Learning Abstract World Models with Neuro-Symbolic Predicates for Robot Planning
entries.description: Learns abstract predicate-level world models for robot planning.

entries.name: ParticleFormer
entries.fullTitle: ParticleFormer: A 3D Point Cloud World Model for Multi-Object, Multi-Material Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: A strong 3D manipulation world model built directly on point clouds rather than only RGB latent video.

entries.name: RoboScape
entries.fullTitle: RoboScape: Physics-informed Embodied World Model
entries.description: Brings explicit physics-aware supervision into embodied video world modeling for contact-rich robot scenarios.

entries.name: RoboDream
entries.fullTitle: RoboDream: Compositional World Models for Scalable Robot Data Synthesis
entries.description: Uses embodiment-aware video generation to synthesize robot demonstrations with novel objects, scenes, and views for data scaling.

entries.name: 3D-VLA
entries.fullTitle: 3D-VLA: A 3D Vision-Language-Action Generative World Model
entries.description: Unifies 3D scene understanding, language, and action in a single generative world model; predicts goal images and point clouds for embodied planning.

entries.name: EVA
entries.fullTitle: EVA: An Embodied World Model for Future Video Anticipation
entries.description: Decomposes video prediction into four meta-tasks; introduces EVA-Bench for evaluating world models in embodied scenarios.

entries.name: STARRY
entries.fullTitle: STARRY: Spatial-Temporal Action-Centric World Modeling for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: A recent action-centric manipulation model that explicitly aligns spatial-temporal prediction with downstream action generation.

entries.name: SKIP
entries.fullTitle: SKIP: Sparse Keyframe Interpolation Paradigm for Efficient Embodied World Models
entries.description: Reduces pixel-space rollout cost by generating sparse task-relevant keyframes before dense interpolation.

entries.name: Embody4D
entries.fullTitle: Embody4D: A Generalist Data Engine for Embodied 4D World Modeling
entries.description: Synthesizes novel camera views from monocular robot videos using 3D-aware compositional training data, confidence-routed latent experts and interaction-aware attention to augment embodied planning and learning.

entries.name: TesserAct
entries.fullTitle: TesserAct: Learning 4D Embodied World Models
entries.description: Learns action-conditioned 4D embodied world models from RGB-DN videos, making dynamic 3D scene evolution explicit for embodied prediction and control.

entries.name: PAIWorld
entries.fullTitle: PAIWorld: A 3D-Consistent World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Adds geometry-aware cross-view attention and 3D priors to improve multi-view consistency for manipulation world models and policy post-training.

entries.name: Mem-World
entries.fullTitle: Mem-World: Memory-Augmented Action-Conditioned World Models for Persistent Robot Manipulation
entries.description: Uses 4D wrist-view-centered surfel memory for persistent, action-conditioned manipulation rollouts under occlusion and fast camera motion.

entries.name: WorldScape
entries.fullTitle: WorldScape: A Unified Real-time World Model Integrating Locomotion and Manipulation

entries.name: SWIM
entries.fullTitle: Structured World Models from Human Videos
entries.description: Trains a world model over a structured, affordance-grounded action space extracted from internet human videos, then fine-tunes with under an hour of real robot interaction for efficient real-world manipulation skill learning.

entries.name: ManiGaussian
entries.fullTitle: ManiGaussian: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting for Multi-task Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Builds a dynamic Gaussian Splatting world model that predicts future scene reconstruction to supervise scene-level spatiotemporal dynamics for language-conditioned multi-task action prediction.

entries.name: ManiGaussian++
entries.fullTitle: ManiGaussian++: General Robotic Bimanual Manipulation with Hierarchical Gaussian World Model
entries.description: Extends ManiGaussian with a hierarchical Gaussian world model that captures multi-body spatiotemporal dynamics for dual-arm collaboration in multi-task bimanual manipulation.

entries.name: DreMa
entries.fullTitle: Dream to Manipulate: Compositional World Models Empowering Robot Imitation Learning with Imagination
entries.description: Constructs learnable digital-twin world models by combining Gaussian Splatting with physics simulators, letting robots imagine novel object configurations and generate imagination-augmented demonstrations for imitation learning.

entries.name: PIVOT-R
entries.fullTitle: PIVOT-R: Primitive-Driven Waypoint-Aware World Model for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Restricts world-model prediction to task-relevant waypoints via primitive action parsing, pairing a waypoint-aware world model with a lightweight action decoder for language-guided manipulation.

entries.name: GAF
entries.fullTitle: GAF: Gaussian Action Field as a 4D Representation for Dynamic World Modeling in Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Extends 3D Gaussian Splatting with learnable motion attributes into a Gaussian Action Field, jointly reconstructing the current scene, predicting future frames, and reasoning actions from motion-aware 4D representations.

entries.name: RoboTransfer
entries.fullTitle: RoboTransfer: Controllable Geometry-Consistent Video Diffusion for Manipulation Policy Transfer
entries.description: Geometry-consistent multi-view video diffusion framework that synthesizes robot manipulation data with fine-grained control over backgrounds and object appearance, improving downstream policy transfer.

entries.name: DreamX-Phi 1.0
entries.fullTitle: DreamX-Phi 1.0: Action-Conditioned Video World Model for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Action-conditioned manipulation video world model that injects per-arm SE(3) transformations via PRoPE-style geometric attention encoding, plus a depth branch and V-JEPA-teacher mask supervision for faithful arm and object dynamics.

entries.name: GeniWorld
entries.fullTitle: GeniWorld: A Generalizable Interactive World Model for Robotic Manipulation via Visual Actions
entries.description: Renders numerical robot actions into URDF-based visual action representations to condition a pretrained video generator, decoupling embodiment kinematics from environment dynamics for out-of-distribution policy interaction and evaluation.

entries.name: ABot-PhysWorld
entries.fullTitle: ABot-PhysWorld: Interactive World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation with Physics Alignment
entries.description: A 14B action-controllable manipulation world model trained on three million physics-annotated clips with DPO-based post-training and decoupled discriminators that suppress object penetration and anti-gravity artifacts, evaluated on the training-independent EZSbench.

entries.name: EmbodiedVAE
entries.fullTitle: EmbodiedVAE: Disentangled Video VAE for Efficient and Controllable Embodied Manipulation
entries.description: Dual-encoder video VAE with asymmetric spatio-temporal compression that disentangles robot-arm motion from scene content, giving manipulation world models compact and controllable latents.

entries.name: S2-HWM
entries.fullTitle: S2-HWM: Sparse Event-Structured Hierarchical World Model for Long-Horizon Surgical Robot Manipulation
entries.description: Learns sparse event evidence from latent trajectories to coordinate an event-level manager and a primitive-step worker, with an event transition model enabling variable-duration imagination for sparse-reward surgical manipulation.

entries.name: EgoGenesis
entries.fullTitle: EgoGenesis: Egocentric World-Action Modeling with Online Anchored Projective Memory and Action-3D RoPE
entries.description: Egocentric world-action simulator that synthesizes controllable manipulation videos using a first-frame 3D scene anchor memory and camera-aware 3D rotary action encoding for precise end-effector control during autoregressive generation.

entries.name: GLAM
entries.fullTitle: GLAM: Training a latent world model over global spatiotemporal memory for active exploration and navigation
entries.description: Jointly predicts future map tokens and waypoint latents from global spatial memory and a navigation goal, supporting exploration and ObjectNav without future RGB reconstruction.

entries.name: CST-WM
entries.fullTitle: CST-WM: A Causally Structured World Model for Embodied Visual Tracking
entries.description: Factorizes target evidence, robot motion, and observation dynamics to prevent spurious direct action effects, then uses predictive control for visual tracking and target reacquisition.

entries.name: Hydra
entries.fullTitle: Hydra: A Navigation World Action Model with Discrete Latent Planning and Continuous Flow-Matching Execution
entries.description: Plans and evaluates discrete kinodynamic intents inside a shared visual-state-action representation, then uses conditional flow matching to produce continuous robot-navigation trajectories.

entries.name: Compatibility-Prediction LWM
entries.fullTitle: Predicting Consequences and Reinforcing Navigation Policies with Latent World Models
entries.description: Predicts action-conditioned latent goal compatibility to train navigation policies from unlabeled video and improve them through reinforcement learning inside the learned model.

entries.name: Deep Active Inference with Diffusion Policy and Multiple Timescale World Model for Real-World Exploration and Navigation
entries.fullTitle: Deep Active Inference with Diffusion Policy and Multiple Timescale World Model for Real-World Exploration and Navigation
entries.description: Combines diffusion action proposals and multi-timescale latent dynamics for active-inference exploration and navigation.

entries.name: Towards Unified World Models for Visual Navigation via Memory-Augmented Planning and Foresight
entries.fullTitle: Towards Unified World Models for Visual Navigation via Memory-Augmented Planning and Foresight
entries.description: Combines visual foresight, hierarchical memory, and action planning in one autoregressive navigation model.

entries.name: Imaginative World Modeling with Scene Graphs for Embodied Agent Navigation
entries.fullTitle: Imaginative World Modeling with Scene Graphs for Embodied Agent Navigation
entries.description: Maintains an evolving scene graph and imagines unseen regions to support semantic navigation and target search.

entries.name: WMNav
entries.fullTitle: WMNav: Integrating Vision-Language Models into World Models for Object Goal Navigation
entries.description: Predicts navigation outcomes with a vision-language world model and updates a curiosity map using discrepancies between prediction and observation.

entries.name: X-MOBILITY
entries.fullTitle: X-MOBILITY: End-To-End Generalizable Navigation via World Modeling
entries.description: Learns autoregressive latent dynamics and decoupled navigation policies using both expert and non-expert trajectories.

entries.name: Rapid Exploration for Open-World Navigation with Latent Goal Models
entries.fullTitle: Rapid Exploration for Open-World Navigation with Latent Goal Models
entries.description: Combines latent goal, distance, and action models with topological visual memory for real-world exploration and navigation.

entries.name: NWM (Navigation World Model)
entries.fullTitle: Navigation World Models
entries.description: Predicts future egocentric observations conditioned on proposed waypoints; supports planning in novel environments without task-specific fine-tuning.

entries.name: EfficientNWM
entries.fullTitle: An Efficient and Multi-Modal Navigation System with One-Step World Model
entries.description: Compresses navigation prediction into a one-step multi-modal world model for faster planning.

entries.name: NavWM
entries.fullTitle: NavWM: A Unified Navigation World Model for Foresight-Driven Planning
entries.description: Unifies latent world reasoning, multimodal trajectory forecasting, and controllable visual generation so navigation policies can plan through visual foresight.

entries.name: MUN
entries.fullTitle: Learning World Models for Unconstrained Goal Navigation
entries.description: A clean goal-navigation formulation where the learned world model supports unconstrained goal reaching rather than one fixed task.

entries.name: Learning 3D Persistent Embodied World Models
entries.fullTitle: Learning 3D Persistent Embodied World Models
entries.description: Important for persistent scene memory and long-horizon embodied interaction in 3D environments.

entries.name: World-Ego Modeling
entries.fullTitle: World-Ego Modeling for Long-Horizon Evolution in Hybrid Embodied Tasks
entries.description: Separates persistent world evolution from robot-centric ego dynamics for hybrid navigation-manipulation tasks.

entries.name: MWM
entries.fullTitle: MWM: Mobile World Models for Action-Conditioned Consistent Prediction
entries.description: Learns action-conditioned mobile-environment transitions for GUI/navigation agents, bridging embodied and app-world modeling.

entries.name: WorldVLN
entries.fullTitle: WorldVLN: Autoregressive World Action Model for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
entries.description: Brings explicit world-model prediction into instruction-conditioned navigation rather than treating VLN as pure policy learning.

entries.name: WorldFly
entries.fullTitle: WorldFly: A World-Model-Based Vision-Language-Action Model for UAV Navigation
entries.description: Couples future video prediction and navigation actions for UAVs, targeting severe occlusion and sharp-viewpoint changes in urban canyon traversal.

entries.name: AirDreamer
entries.fullTitle: AirDreamer: Generalist Drone Navigation with World Models
entries.description: Uses a world-model-based environment-understanding module to transfer drone navigation to unseen cluttered environments without deployment tuning.

entries.name: MAD / Mapping-Aware Dreamer
entries.fullTitle: MAD: Mapping-Aware World Models for Agile Quadrotor Flight
entries.description: Adds geometry-aware memory to Dreamer-style quadrotor flight, improving agile control under partial visibility and tight latency.

entries.name: Quadrotor WM Generalization
entries.fullTitle: Generalization of World Models under Environmental Variability for Vision-based Quadrotor Navigation
entries.description: Systematic sim-to-real study showing that SSL-stage world-model robustness predicts real quadrotor deployment better than simulation reward alone.

entries.name: 3D Isovist World Model
entries.fullTitle: A 3D Isovist World Model: Revealing a City's Unseen Geometry and Its Emergent Cross-City Signature
entries.description: Predicts navigable negative space rather than appearance, giving city-scale agents a lightweight geometric world state for spatial reasoning.

entries.name: RAE-NWM
entries.fullTitle: RAE-NWM: Navigation World Model in Dense Visual Representation Space
entries.description: Replaces heavily compressed VAE latents with denser visual representations, improving navigation rollouts that depend on fine structural details.

entries.name: MindJourney
entries.fullTitle: MindJourney: Test-Time Scaling with World Models for Spatial Reasoning
entries.description: Uses world-model rollouts at test time for spatial reasoning and navigation-style lookahead.

entries.name: NavMorph
entries.fullTitle: NavMorph: A Self-Evolving World Model for Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments
entries.description: Adds self-evolving memory and foresight to continuous-environment VLN, making the navigation world model adaptive online.

entries.name: Language-Conditioned World Modeling for Visual Navigation
entries.fullTitle: Language-Conditioned World Modeling for Visual Navigation
entries.description: Frames instruction-following visual navigation itself as language-conditioned world modeling, adding an explicit benchmark and open-loop prediction setup.

entries.name: Policy-Guided World Model Planning for Language-Conditioned Visual Navigation
entries.fullTitle: Policy-Guided World Model Planning for Language-Conditioned Visual Navigation
entries.description: Combines policy priors with latent world-model planning to stabilize long-horizon instruction-conditioned navigation.

entries.name: 3D-Anchored Lookahead Planning
entries.fullTitle: 3D-Anchored Lookahead Planning for Persistent Robotic Scene Memory via World-Model-Based MCTS
entries.description: Couples persistent 3D scene memory with lookahead planning, useful for long-horizon robotic exploration.

entries.name: GenEx
entries.fullTitle: GenEx: Generating an Explorable World
entries.description: Generates a panoramic environment from a single image, rolls it forward with panoramic video diffusion under agent movement commands, and feeds the imagined observations back to update a GPT-driven agent's beliefs for exploration and planning, with spatial coherence measured via loop-closure consistency.

entries.name: Pathdreamer
entries.fullTitle: Pathdreamer: A World Model for Indoor Navigation
entries.description: Maintains an accumulating 3D point-cloud of previously observed views across navigation steps, uses it to synthesize the next 360° panorama under trajectory actions with reprojection-consistent revisits, and demonstrates look-ahead rollouts that improve vision-and-language navigation planning.

entries.name: SIMA
entries.fullTitle: Scaling Instructable Agents Across Many Simulated Worlds
entries.description: A language-instructable agent across simulated worlds that combines image-text and video-prediction representations, recurrent memory and behavioral cloning to produce keyboard and mouse actions.

entries.name: WNM-3D
entries.fullTitle: WNM-3D: A World Navigation Model with 3D Scene Conditioning for Closed-Loop VLN
entries.description: Conditions joint future-view and action generation on geometry-aware representations extracted by a frozen feed-forward geometry encoder from the observed history, targeting closed-loop continuous vision-language navigation.

entries.name: UniNav
entries.fullTitle: UniNav: A Unified World-Action Diffusion Model for Visual Navigation
entries.description: Jointly denoises future visual observations and continuous waypoint trajectories in a single diffusion transformer with geometry-aware camera tokens, co-training on trajectory-labeled navigation data and video-only data.

entries.name: SC²-WM
entries.fullTitle: SC²-WM: A Self-Correcting World Model with Closed-Loop Feedback for Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments
entries.description: Derives internal feedback from world-model foresight to refine navigation plans before execution and selectively updates the world model at test time when feedback reveals model capacity insufficiency.

entries.name: UA-NWM
entries.fullTitle: Uncertainty-Aware World Model for Aerial Image-Goal Navigation
entries.description: Formulates UAV trajectory scoring as conditional out-of-distribution detection, representing plausible futures with an uncertainty subspace and ranking candidates by the unexplainable residual of the prediction-goal discrepancy.

entries.name: FlowPilot
entries.fullTitle: FlowPilot: Real-Time World-Action Modeling for Agile UAV Navigation
entries.description: Compact UAV world-action model that jointly denoises future depth observations and Bernstein-polynomial trajectories with flow matching, running action-centrically onboard for agile real-time navigation.

entries.name: EndoWAM
entries.fullTitle: EndoWAM: A Grounded World-Action Model for Generalizable Endoscopic Navigation
entries.description: First world-action model for robotic endoscopy, adding future grounding that predicts task-relevant target regions in future observations to handle tissue deformation, occlusion, and rapid viewpoint change.

entries.name: Monotone-Cost Latent Nav-WM
entries.fullTitle: Latent World Models with Monotone Planning Costs for Image-Goal Navigation
entries.description: Trains a DINO-based latent navigation world model with an autoregressive rollout loss and a Monotone Cost Ranking loss so that CEM planners receive planning costs that reliably order candidate action sequences.

entries.name: DF³
entries.fullTitle: DF³: World Modeling via Decoder-Free Feature Forecasting in Autonomous Navigation
entries.description: Forecasts future states entirely in the latent space of a frozen vision foundation model via learnable spatial queries and derives navigation task outputs directly, eliminating pixel decoders from the world-modeling loop.

entries.name: PEF Endovascular WM
entries.fullTitle: Progressive Experience Fusion for Multi-Task World Model Control in Endovascular Navigation
entries.description: Trains a multi-task TD-MPC2 controller with progressive experience fusion and adaptive-horizon MPPI planning, achieving 90% success in held-out vasculatures for autonomous endovascular navigation.

entries.name: Depth-Regularized JEPA-WM
entries.fullTitle: Depth-Regularized JEPA World Models Learn More Transferable Representations from Real Outdoor Robot Data
entries.description: Combines depth supervision with an isotropy-inducing latent regularizer to learn robust latent dynamics from real agricultural-robot video, improving transferability of outdoor navigation world models.

entries.name: JEPLO
entries.fullTitle: JEPLO: Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for LiDAR-Based Legged Locomotion
entries.description: Learns predictive terrain representations from LiDAR and proprioception with a JEPA teacher-student pipeline for robust legged locomotion and sim-to-real transfer.

entries.name: DWMP
entries.fullTitle: DWMP: Leveraging Dual World Models for Humanoid Obstacle Traversal
entries.description: Combines a Koopman model of proprioceptive dynamics with an RSSM visual world model to supply complementary predictive features for humanoid obstacle traversal.

entries.name: CAP
entries.fullTitle: CAP: Continuously Adaptive Perception-Blind Humanoid Locomotion via Learned Denoising
entries.description: Combines an action-conditioned DreamerV3 RSSM trained to denoise depth with a proprioceptive pathway, helping humanoid locomotion tolerate degraded and intermittent terrain observations.

entries.name: WM-LOCO
entries.fullTitle: World-Model-Augmented Visual Locomotion for Humanoids on Foothold-Constrained Terrain
entries.description: Jointly learns recurrent future-observation and reward features with a PPO policy for humanoid traversal of gaps, stepping stones, and narrow footholds using onboard depth.

entries.name: ProTerrain
entries.fullTitle: ProTerrain: Probabilistic Physics-Informed Rough Terrain World Modeling
entries.description: Models spatially correlated terrain uncertainty and propagates it through differentiable physics for probabilistic robot-motion prediction.

entries.name: World Model-based Perception for Visual Legged Locomotion
entries.fullTitle: World Model-based Perception for Visual Legged Locomotion
entries.description: Learns visual dynamics that provide policy state for legged locomotion and evaluates trajectory prediction after simulation-to-real transfer.

entries.name: Hierarchical World Models for Humanoid Control
entries.fullTitle: Hierarchical World Models as Visual Whole-Body Humanoid Controllers
entries.description: Multi-level JEPA world models controlling full humanoid body; imagination-based whole-body planning.

entries.name: Lifting Embodied World Models for Planning and Control
entries.fullTitle: Lifting Embodied World Models for Planning and Control
entries.description: Lifts low-level action spaces into more interpretable high-level controls, making embodied world-model planning substantially easier.

entries.name: Ego-VCP
entries.fullTitle: Ego-Vision World Model for Humanoid Contact Planning
entries.description: Egocentric world model for humanoid contact planning, a useful bridge between vision prediction and full-body control.

entries.name: RWM-U
entries.fullTitle: Uncertainty-Aware Robotic World Model Makes Offline Model-Based Reinforcement Learning Work on Real Robots
entries.description: Propagates epistemic uncertainty through autoregressive robot-state rollouts and trains policies with uncertainty-penalized MOPO-PPO, enabling offline learning for manipulation and real-robot locomotion.

entries.name: Denoising World Model Learning
entries.fullTitle: Advancing Humanoid Locomotion: Mastering Challenging Terrains with Denoising World Model Learning
entries.description: Uses denoising world-model learning to improve humanoid locomotion over challenging terrain.

entries.name: DynaWM
entries.fullTitle: DynaWM: Dynamics-Aware Distillation with World Model and Momentum Targets for Smooth Locomotion over Continuous Stairs
entries.description: Uses a world-model regularizer and momentum targets to preserve terrain geometry and forward-dynamics awareness for smooth bipedal-wheeled stair locomotion.

entries.name: Robotic World Model
entries.fullTitle: Robotic World Model: A Neural Network Simulator for Robust Policy Optimization in Robotics
entries.description: Learns a neural simulator for robot policy optimization, filling the sim-to-real gap with a learned dynamics model.

entries.name: TD-MPC2
entries.fullTitle: TD-MPC2: Scalable, Robust World Models for Continuous Control
entries.description: Temporal Difference Learning with Model Predictive Control; scales across 104 continuous control tasks.

entries.name: 1X World Model Challenge Report
entries.fullTitle: Generative World Modelling for Humanoids: 1X World Model Challenge Technical Report
entries.description: First-place solution to both tracks of the 1X humanoid world model challenge, adapting Wan-2.2 TI2V-5B for robot-state-conditioned future frame sampling and training a spatio-temporal transformer for future latent-code compression.

entries.name: HWM
entries.fullTitle: Humanoid World Models: Open World Foundation Models for Humanoid Robotics
entries.description: Family of lightweight open-source masked-transformer and flow-matching models that forecast future egocentric video conditioned on humanoid control tokens, trained on 100 hours of humanoid demonstrations.

entries.name: PEVA
entries.fullTitle: Whole-Body Conditioned Egocentric Video Prediction
entries.description: Trains an autoregressive conditional diffusion transformer on Nymeria to predict egocentric video from relative 3D whole-body pose actions, simulating how physical human actions reshape the first-person view.

entries.name: DreamMimic
entries.fullTitle: DreamMimic: Learning Visuomotor Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation via World Model
entries.description: Distills privileged teacher policies into vision-based humanoid controllers by repurposing an RSSM as an action-conditioned multi-step supervision signal and predictive feature source, with auxiliary heads for privileged state, contact, and object state.

entries.name: GigaBrain-WBC-0.5
entries.fullTitle: GigaBrain-WBC-0.5: A Behavior World Model for Robust Whole-Body Control with Environment Interaction
entries.description: First Behavior World Model for humanoid whole-body control: a causal transformer jointly predicts next action, next state, and the distribution over next latent behavior commands so tracking stays robust when terrain and object contact reshape dynamics.

entries.name: LUCID
entries.fullTitle: LUCID: Latent-Skill Unified Control via Imagined Dynamics for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
entries.description: Hierarchical MBRL framework that freezes a latent-conditioned low-level skill policy and learns a macro-dynamics world model whose imagined rollouts of temporally extended transitions optimize the high-level humanoid policy.

entries.name: ω-0
entries.fullTitle: ω-0: A Latent Predictive World Action Model for Concurrent Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
entries.description: Whole-body world-action model that predicts controller-compatible action latents for real humanoid loco-manipulation, coupling compact future-observation embeddings with diffusion-based whole-body action generation instead of reconstructing future videos.

entries.name: DECOWAM
entries.fullTitle: DECOWAM: Decoupled Whole-Body World-Action Model for Legged Mobile Manipulation
entries.description: Separates camera ego-motion from base and arm actions through dedicated conditional interfaces on a frozen FastWAM backbone, and introduces the ARMDOG real-robot dataset synchronizing video, whole-body state/action, and language.

entries.name: GraphOp-WM
entries.fullTitle: Graph-Operator World Models for Morphology-Parameter Generalization in Continuous Control
entries.description: Represents articulated robots as attributed graphs and factorizes transitions into a morphology-independent local dynamics basis plus a morphology-conditioned structured operator, generalizing world models to unseen link lengths, masses, and actuation.

entries.name: DayDreamer
entries.fullTitle: DayDreamer: World Models for Physical Robot Learning
entries.description: Trains Dreamer directly on physical robots (quadruped walking in ~1 hour) without a simulator — the first widely cited real-robot RSSM world-model result. (Also in the §2.1 Dreamer-family table.)

entries.name: DIDO
entries.fullTitle: DIDO: Distilling Interaction-Centric Dynamics into One-Step Denoising for World Action Models
entries.description: Distills multi-step WAM denoising into one step with interaction-focused gripper and object supervision, preserving manipulation dynamics while reducing control latency.

entries.name: MaP-WAM
entries.fullTitle: Memory as Plans: World-Action Modeling with Memory-Grounded Planning
entries.description: Converts episodic visual-language memory into compact segment plans and uses joint action-progress prediction for execution with fixed context length and adaptive plan transitions.

entries.name: HaWMPO
entries.fullTitle: HaWMPO: Hallucination-Aware World Model-based Policy Optimization for Generalist Robot Policy
entries.description: Estimates hallucination risk in action-conditioned imagined rollouts and discounts unreliable action chunks during reinforcement-learning post-training of VLA policies.

entries.name: JEPA Policy
entries.fullTitle: JEPA Policy: Diffusion-Free Imitation Learning via Paired Action and Future Representation Prediction
entries.description: Jointly refines action chunks and their paired future representations in a shared Transformer, using predictive supervision for low-latency imitation without diffusion sampling.

entries.name: WorldAgen
entries.fullTitle: WorldAgen: Unified State-Action Prediction with Test-Time World Model Training
entries.description: Shares state- and action-prediction machinery and adapts its world model at deployment using a small number of exploratory state transitions to improve robot policies under dynamics shifts.

entries.name: OpenWAM
entries.fullTitle: OpenWAM: An Open, Modular Exploration Towards Systematic World-Action Model Pretraining
entries.description: Provides modular WAM training and evaluation infrastructure with controlled studies of generative priors, world-action information flow, and embodied pretraining, plus an open pretrained model.

entries.name: ProWAM
entries.fullTitle: Learning to Use Imagination: Progress-Conditioned Future Utilization for World Action Models
entries.description: Models execution progress to adapt both overall reliance on imagined futures and the relevance of individual future latents during robotic manipulation.

entries.name: GE-Act 2.0
entries.fullTitle: GE-Act 2.0: Pretraining and Scaling a World-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Pretrains a control-oriented autoencoder, single-step visual planner, and inverse dynamics model from scratch, then selectively aligns predicted futures with action supervision across embodiments.

entries.name: TacPAC
entries.fullTitle: TacPAC: Tactile Prediction and Real-Time Action Correction in World-Action Models for Contact-Rich Manipulation
entries.description: Caches predicted tactile contact and the planned action representation, then uses incoming touch observations to correct unexecuted actions without regenerating the full chunk.

entries.name: GIFT
entries.fullTitle: GIFT: Guided Intermediate Feature Training via Action-Oriented Structural Supervision for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Adds training-time geometry, affordance, and goal-region supervision to intermediate VLA and WAM features, improving manipulation transfer while retaining each policy's action formulation.

entries.name: WISE
entries.fullTitle: WISE: World-model-guided Imagination Scheduling for Efficient Post-training of Vision-Language-Action Models
entries.description: Schedules bounded multi-view imagination at interaction-relevant states and converts ranked future progress into supervision for efficient VLA policy refinement.

entries.name: SA-WAM
entries.fullTitle: Spatially Aware World Action Model via Geometric Latent Diffusion
entries.description: Jointly predicts actions, RGB, and depth within a pretrained video-diffusion backbone, using bounded depth encoding to retain the frozen tokenizer and improve spatially grounded control.

entries.name: REFACTOR-VLA
entries.fullTitle: REFACTOR-VLA: Unsupervised Library Learning of Typed Motor Programs
entries.description: Uses learned-world-model rollouts to group behaviorally equivalent motor fragments, admitting reusable typed skills through compression and return-preservation checks before policy execution.

entries.name: ZimaBlue
entries.fullTitle: ZimaBlue: Evolving Generalizable World Action Models through Scalable Video Pre-training
entries.description: Transfers large-scale egocentric video dynamics into robot actions through staged video-action training and an asynchronous slow world model with a fast action-prediction branch.

entries.name: PAVE
entries.fullTitle: PAVE: Predictive Alignment and Value-Guided Evolution for World-Action Policies
entries.description: Combines training-only multi-horizon JEPA alignment with value-conditioned policy improvement, learning dynamics from all valid trajectories while retaining efficient direct action generation.

entries.name: Motus2
entries.fullTitle: Motus2: A Self-Evolving General World Model for Dexterous Manipulation
entries.description: Unifies policy, action-conditioned simulator, and value-evaluator interfaces in shared weights, coupling candidate imagination with policy improvement for tactile dexterous manipulation.

entries.name: AcrossWAM1.0
entries.fullTitle: AcrossWAM1.0:A Modular Latent World-Action Stack for Compact Robot Policies
entries.description: Modularizes a latent world-action policy into adapters, retained scene-grounded prediction, and a flow-matching executor, evaluating compact backbones and auditable deployment exports.

entries.name: LEON
entries.fullTitle: Making Latent Evolution Explicit: Operator-Structured Transitions for World Action Models
entries.description: Structures latent WAM transitions as context-dependent operator propagation plus additive forcing, testing whether evolution-specific inductive structure improves closed-loop control.

entries.name: Riemann-1.0
entries.fullTitle: Riemann-1.0: An Embodied World Action Model for Physical AI
entries.description: Jointly autoregresses visual observations, robot states, and actions, unifying multi-embodiment simulation and policy execution through progressive human-to-robot embodied pretraining.

entries.name: Zero-WAM
entries.fullTitle: Zero-WAM: In-Context World-Action Modeling from Human Videos for Open-Ended Task Generalization
entries.description: Conditions causal video-action prediction on human demonstrations and trains future-chunk prediction with generated human-robot pairs to generalize to unseen manipulation tasks.

entries.name: GaussianDream++
entries.fullTitle: GaussianDream++: Efficient 3D Gaussian World Modeling for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Adds compact world-state and world-prediction tokens with training-only current and future Gaussian supervision, preserving efficient direct VLA execution after auxiliary components are removed.

entries.name: LAWA
entries.fullTitle: Latent Action as Intention Enables Efficient Future Imagination for World Action Models
entries.description: Jointly denoises compact latent intentions and executable actions, retaining future imagination while omitting the future-video branch during robot-policy inference.

entries.name: GaussianWAM
entries.fullTitle: GaussianWAM: Distilling Geometry and Semantics from 3D Gaussian Fields into World-Action Models
entries.description: Distills geometric and semantic supervision through shared 3D Gaussian primitives into WAM representations during training, leaving the deployment architecture unchanged.

entries.name: TrAct
entries.fullTitle: TrAct: Bridging Robot Control and Visual Prediction with Visual Tracks
entries.description: Links candidate robot actions to visual tracks, predicts track-conditioned futures, and ranks their task outcomes with a vision-language reward model before execution.

entries.name: GlanceWAM
entries.fullTitle: GlanceWAM: Sparse Test-Time Imagination for World-Action Models
entries.description: Runs sparse visual lookahead asynchronously while an action head operates at control rate, using isolated attention and staleness-aware training to consume aging imagined futures.

entries.name: InternVLA-A1.5
entries.fullTitle: InternVLA-A1.5: Unifying Understanding, Latent Foresight, and Action for Compositional Generalization
entries.description: Distills future dynamics from a frozen video generator into compact latent foresight tokens for real-time robot policies.

entries.name: Kairos
entries.fullTitle: Kairos: A Regret-Aware Native World-Action Model Stack for Physical AI
entries.description: Combines cross-embodiment pretraining and multi-timescale state maintenance for control-relevant world-action prediction.

entries.name: GaussianDream
entries.fullTitle: GaussianDream: A Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian World Model for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Supervises VLA latent queries with current 3D Gaussian structure and future Gaussian evolution during training.

entries.name: Vidarc
entries.fullTitle: Vidarc: Embodied Video Diffusion Model for Closed-loop Control
entries.description: Combines autoregressive video diffusion, action-relevant masks, and inverse dynamics for low-latency closed-loop robot control.

entries.name: ViPRA
entries.fullTitle: ViPRA: Video Prediction for Robot Actions
entries.description: Predicts future observations and motion-centric latent actions from actionless videos, then decodes them into robot-specific controls.

entries.name: VLA-RFT
entries.fullTitle: VLA-RFT: Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Fine-tuning with Verified Rewards in World Simulators
entries.description: Fine-tunes VLA policies using action-conditioned world-simulator rollouts and goal-reference rewards.

entries.name: World-Env
entries.fullTitle: World-Env: Leveraging World Model as a Virtual Environment for VLA Post-Training
entries.description: Uses a predictive visual simulator with language-based rewards and termination detection for VLA reinforcement post-training.

entries.name: Physical Autoregressive Model for Robotic Manipulation without Action Pretraining
entries.fullTitle: Physical Autoregressive Model for Robotic Manipulation without Action Pretraining
entries.description: Jointly predicts physical frame-action tokens using autoregressive video pretraining without action pretraining.

entries.name: DreamVLA
entries.fullTitle: DreamVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model Dreamed with Comprehensive World Knowledge
entries.description: Forecasts dynamic, spatial, and semantic world representations and uses inverse dynamics for robotic action generation.

entries.name: Goal-VLA
entries.fullTitle: Goal-VLA: Image-Generative VLMs as Object-Centric World Models Empowering Zero-shot Robot Manipulation
entries.description: Uses generated object-centric goal states with iterative visual reflection to guide zero-shot manipulation.

entries.name: Unified Vision-Language-Action Model
entries.fullTitle: Unified Vision-Language-Action Model
entries.description: Autoregressively models vision, language, and actions and uses predictive world-model post-training for robot-policy transfer.

entries.name: UP-VLA
entries.fullTitle: UP-VLA: A Unified Understanding and Prediction Model for Embodied Agent
entries.description: Jointly trains multimodal understanding and future prediction to improve spatial reasoning and embodied action control.

entries.name: CheckVLA
entries.fullTitle: CheckVLA: Execution-Time Verification with Action-Conditioned World Model for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
entries.description: Restores closed-loop feedback to chunked VLA execution using a separately trained action-conditioned world model. Conformally calibrated risk estimates trigger intervention and suffix repair when observed outcomes diverge from expected action effects.

entries.name: Masked Visual Actions
entries.fullTitle: Masked Visual Actions for Unified World Modeling
entries.description: Introduces a pixel-space action interface based on partially revealed entity trajectories. The same video model supports forward dynamics, policy evaluation, model-based planning, and inverse action generation across scenes and robot embodiments.

entries.name: AeroAct
entries.fullTitle: AeroAct: Action-Centered World-Action Models for Language-Conditioned Quadrotor Flight
entries.description: Extends action-centered world-action modeling to language-conditioned quadrotor flight, using future visual observations as dense training supervision while decoding dynamically executable actions directly at deployment.

entries.name: FlowWAM
entries.fullTitle: FlowWAM: Optical Flow as a Unified Action Representation for World Action Models
entries.description: Uses optical-flow videos as a shared video-native action representation, enabling one diffusion framework to perform both action prediction and flow-guided future-video generation.

entries.name: WALA
entries.fullTitle: WALA: Learning Executable Latent Actions from Action-Labeled Demonstrations and Action-Free Videos
entries.description: Learns executable latent actions from labeled demonstrations and action-free videos by predicting future semantic and geometric changes in DINOv3 and depth feature spaces.

entries.name: Lumo-2
entries.fullTitle: Towards Predictive, Aligned, and Scalable Robot Learning
entries.description: A latent world-action model that generates robot actions through predictive reasoning over world dynamics, with progressive alignment across dynamics, vision, language, and action representations.

entries.name: V-JEPA 2
entries.fullTitle: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning
entries.description: Meta's flagship world model. Pretrained on >1M hours of internet video, then fine-tuned on <62h of robot trajectories for zero-shot manipulation on real Franka arms — no task-specific rewards.

entries.name: WLA
entries.fullTitle: World-Language-Action Model for Unified World Modeling, Language Reasoning, and Action Synthesis
entries.description: Defines world-language-action models that jointly predict textual subtasks, subgoal images, and robot actions, bridging WAM-style dynamics and VLA-style language reasoning.

entries.name: WSA₁
entries.fullTitle: WSA₁: a 3D-Centric World-Spatial-Action Model for Generalizable Robot Control
entries.description: Couples 3D world-aware visual prediction with world-state/action constraints to improve data-efficient generalization across robot manipulation tasks.

entries.name: LaWAM
entries.fullTitle: LaWAM: Latent World Action Models for Efficient Dynamics-Aware Robot Policies
entries.description: Replaces expensive future-video generation with compact latent visual subgoals, exposing predictive dynamics to low-latency robot policies.

entries.name: A2World
entries.fullTitle: Learning Transferable Dynamics Priors from Action to World Modeling
entries.description: Pretrains an action-conditioned multi-view world model and transfers the resulting dynamics priors to both learned simulators and video-action policies.

entries.name: Efficient Sim-to-Real WAM
entries.fullTitle: Efficient Sim-to-Real Transfer of World-Action Models from Synthetic Priors
entries.description: Studies zero-shot deployment of a world-action model trained from synthetic robot demonstrations, providing an explicit sim-to-real route for WAMs.

entries.name: KAM-WM
entries.fullTitle: KAM-WM: Kinematic Affordance Maps from Latent World Models for Robot Manipulation
entries.description: Extracts task-conditioned directional affordances from a frozen latent video world model without rollout or world-model fine-tuning.

entries.name: DSWAM
entries.fullTitle: DSWAM: A Dual-System World Action Foundation Model for Fine-Grained Robot Manipulation
entries.description: Combines a default WAM executor with an optional vision-language subtask planner, separating fine-grained execution from coarse instruction decomposition.

entries.name: Worldscape-MoE
entries.fullTitle: Worldscape-MoE: A Unified Mixture-of-Experts World Model for Scalable Heterogeneous Action Control
entries.description: Uses shared and control-specific experts to unify camera, locomotion, manipulation, and hand-joint action interfaces under a common physical world model.

entries.name: ABot-M0.5
entries.fullTitle: ABot-M0.5: Unified Mobility-and-Manipulation World Action Model
entries.description: Aligns temporal granularity, disentangles navigation and manipulation actions, and trains inverse dynamics on model-predicted videos for mobile manipulation.

entries.name: AdaWAM
entries.fullTitle: Dreaming when Necessary: Advancing World Action Models with Adaptive Multi-Modal Reasoning
entries.description: Routes between textual reasoning for task transitions and visual reasoning for precise manipulation through an adaptive WAM router.

entries.name: AGRA
entries.fullTitle: Making Foresight Actionable: Repurposing Representation Alignment in World Action Models
entries.description: Aligns video-diffusion features with action-grounded visual representations so predicted futures focus the action decoder on task-relevant interaction regions.

entries.name: FAWAM
entries.fullTitle: FAWAM: Force-Aware World Action Models for Closed-Loop Contact-Rich Manipulation
entries.description: Extends WAMs with force/torque prediction and force-aware action generation for closed-loop, contact-rich manipulation.

entries.name: RoboFlow4D
entries.fullTitle: RoboFlow4D: A Lightweight Flow World Model Toward Real-Time Flow-Guided Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Predicts lightweight 4D flow futures that guide real-time robotic manipulation without decoding full future videos.

entries.name: Feedback-WM
entries.fullTitle: Feedback World Model Enables Precise Guidance of Diffusion Policy
entries.description: Uses observer-style latent feedback and counterfactual uncertainty to steer a diffusion policy under distribution shift.

entries.name: EgoExo-WM
entries.fullTitle: EgoExo-WM: Unlocking Exo Video for Ego World Models
entries.description: Converts exocentric video into training signals for an egocentric, action-conditioned latent world model and goal-directed planning.

entries.name: SWEET
entries.fullTitle: SWEET: Sparse World Modeling with Image Editing for Embodied Task Execution
entries.description: Uses sparse, task-critical edited keyframes as visual world-model futures for faster embodied task execution.

entries.name: MoLA
entries.fullTitle: From Imagined Futures to Executable Actions: Mixture of Latent Actions for Robot Manipulation
entries.description: Represents imagined futures through multiple semantic, depth, and flow latent-action channels before decoding executable manipulation actions.

entries.name: HarmoWAM
entries.fullTitle: HarmoWAM: Harmonizing Generalizable and Precise Manipulation via Adaptive World Action Models
entries.description: Adaptively combines a generalizable video world model with a precise reactive expert for manipulation across transit and contact phases.

entries.name: ALAM
entries.fullTitle: ALAM: Algebraically Consistent Latent Action Model for Vision-Language-Action Models
entries.description: Learns algebraically consistent latent actions from action-free video and jointly couples those transitions with robot action generation.

entries.name: UniPi
entries.fullTitle: Learning Universal Policies via Text-Guided Video Generation

entries.name: AVDC
entries.fullTitle: Learning to Act from Actionless Videos through Dense Correspondences

entries.name: VLP
entries.fullTitle: Video Language Planning

entries.name: GR-1
entries.fullTitle: Unleashing Large-Scale Video Generative Pre-training for Visual Robot Manipulation

entries.name: ARDuP
entries.fullTitle: ARDuP: Active Region Video Diffusion for Universal Policies

entries.name: Dreamitate
entries.fullTitle: Dreamitate: Real-World Visuomotor Policy Learning via Video Generation

entries.name: This&That
entries.fullTitle: This&That: Language-Gesture Controlled Video Generation for Robot Planning

entries.name: Im2Flow2Act
entries.fullTitle: Flow as the Cross-Domain Manipulation Interface

entries.name: GR-MG
entries.fullTitle: GR-MG: Leveraging Partially Annotated Data via Multi-Modal Goal-Conditioned Policy
entries.description: Combines language and goal-image conditioning with a progress-guided diffusion model for generating future visual goals, allowing robot-policy learning from partially annotated data.

entries.name: Gen2Act
entries.fullTitle: Gen2Act: Human Video Generation in Novel Scenarios enables Generalizable Robot Manipulation
entries.description: Conditions robot policies on human-motion videos generated by a pretrained video model, using task-specific imagined demonstrations to generalize manipulation to novel scenarios.

entries.name: GR-2
entries.fullTitle: GR-2: A Generative Video-Language-Action Model with Web-Scale Knowledge for Robot Manipulation

entries.name: PAD
entries.fullTitle: Prediction with Action: Visual Policy Learning via Joint Denoising Process

entries.name: VPP
entries.fullTitle: Video Prediction Policy: A Generalist Robot Policy with Predictive Visual Representations
entries.description: Extracts predictive visual representations from a video diffusion model and conditions an implicit inverse-dynamics policy on them for generalist robot manipulation.

entries.name: VILP
entries.fullTitle: VILP: Imitation Learning with Latent Video Planning

entries.name: CoT-VLA
entries.fullTitle: CoT-VLA: Visual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models

entries.name: RoboEnvision
entries.fullTitle: RoboEnvision: A Long-Horizon Video Generation Model for Multi-Task Robot Manipulation

entries.name: RIGVid
entries.fullTitle: Robotic Manipulation by Imitating Generated Videos Without Physical Demonstrations

entries.name: 4DGen
entries.fullTitle: Geometry-aware 4D Video Generation for Robot Manipulation

entries.name: Vidar
entries.fullTitle: Vidar: Embodied Video Diffusion Model for Generalist Manipulation

entries.name: Video Policy
entries.fullTitle: Video Generators are Robot Policies

entries.name: F1
entries.fullTitle: F1: A Vision-Language-Action Model Bridging Understanding and Generation to Actions

entries.name: 3D-FDP
entries.fullTitle: 3D Flow Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Generating Flow in 3D Space

entries.name: NovaFlow
entries.fullTitle: NovaFlow: Zero-Shot Manipulation via Actionable Flow from Generated Videos

entries.name: DUST
entries.fullTitle: Dual-Stream Diffusion for World-Model Augmented Vision-Language-Action Model

entries.name: UD-VLA
entries.fullTitle: Unified Diffusion VLA: Vision-Language-Action Model via Joint Discrete Denoising Diffusion Process
entries.description: Jointly denoises discrete future-image and robot-action tokens in a unified token space, coupling visual prediction with action generation.

entries.name: RynnVLA-002
entries.fullTitle: RynnVLA-002: A Unified Vision-Language-Action and World Model

entries.name: TraceGen
entries.fullTitle: TraceGen: World Modeling in 3D Trace Space Enables Learning from Cross-Embodiment Videos

entries.name: Audio-WM
entries.fullTitle: Learning Robot Manipulation from Audio World Models

entries.name: HiF-VLA
entries.fullTitle: HiF-VLA: Hindsight, Insight and Foresight through Motion Representation for Vision-Language-Action Models

entries.name: CoVAR
entries.fullTitle: CoVAR: Co-generation of Video and Action for Robotic Manipulation via Multi-Modal Diffusion

entries.name: LVP
entries.fullTitle: Large Video Planner Enables Generalizable Robot Control

entries.name: Act2Goal
entries.fullTitle: Act2Goal: From World Model To General Goal-conditioned Policy

entries.name: Dream2Flow
entries.fullTitle: Dream2Flow: Bridging Video Generation and Open-World Manipulation with 3D Object Flow

entries.name: PALM
entries.fullTitle: PALM: Progress-Aware Policy Learning via Affordance Reasoning for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation

entries.name: Cosmos Policy
entries.fullTitle: Cosmos Policy: Fine-Tuning Video Models for Visuomotor Control and Planning

entries.name: TC-IDM
entries.fullTitle: TC-IDM: Grounding Video Generation for Executable Zero-shot Robot Motion

entries.name: BagelVLA
entries.fullTitle: BagelVLA: Enhancing Long-Horizon Manipulation via Interleaved Vision-Language-Action Generation

entries.name: MVISTA-4D
entries.fullTitle: MVISTA-4D: View-Consistent 4D World Model with Test-Time Action Inference for Robotic Manipulation

entries.name: Say-Dream-Act
entries.fullTitle: Say, Dream, and Act: Learning Video World Models for Instruction-Driven Robot Manipulation

entries.name: GigaBrain-0.5M*
entries.fullTitle: GigaBrain-0.5M*: a VLA That Learns From World Model-Based Reinforcement Learning

entries.name: Dex4D
entries.fullTitle: Dex4D: Task-Agnostic Point Track Policy for Sim-to-Real Dexterous Manipulation

entries.name: PhysGen
entries.fullTitle: Learning Physics from Pretrained Video Models: A Multimodal Continuous and Sequential World Interaction Models for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Uses shared continuous video-action tokens and autoregressive video prediction to transfer physical dynamics from pretrained video models to manipulation, with look-ahead action prediction and inverse-kinematics reasoning.

entries.name: FRAPPE
entries.fullTitle: FRAPPE: Infusing World Modeling into Generalist Policies via Multiple Future Representation Alignment

entries.name: AdaWorldPolicy
entries.fullTitle: AdaWorldPolicy: World-Model-Driven Diffusion Policy with Online Adaptive Learning for Robotic Manipulation

entries.name: NovaPlan
entries.fullTitle: NovaPlan: Zero-Shot Long-Horizon Manipulation via Closed-Loop Video Language Planning

entries.name: EmboAlign
entries.fullTitle: EmboAlign: Aligning Video Generation with Compositional Constraints for Zero-Shot Manipulation

entries.name: AeroPlace-Flow
entries.fullTitle: AeroPlace-Flow: Language-Grounded Object Placement for Aerial Manipulators via Visual Foresight and Object Flow

entries.name: ICLR-VR
entries.fullTitle: ICLR: In-Context Imitation Learning with Visual Reasoning

entries.name: 3PoinTr
entries.fullTitle: 3PoinTr: 3D Point Tracks for Learning Manipulation from Unconstrained Human Videos
entries.description: Predicts dense, visibility-aware 3D point tracks from unconstrained human videos and uses them as motion priors for a closed-loop robot manipulation policy.

entries.name: DiT4DiT
entries.fullTitle: DiT4DiT: Jointly Modeling Video Dynamics and Actions for Generalizable Robot Control

entries.name: S-VAM
entries.fullTitle: S-VAM: Shortcut Video-Action Model by Self-Distilling Geometric and Semantic Foresight

entries.name: EVA
entries.fullTitle: EVA: Aligning Video World Models with Executable Robot Actions via Inverse Dynamics Rewards

entries.name: GigaWorld-Policy-0.5
entries.fullTitle: GigaWorld-Policy-0.5: A Faster and Stronger WAM Empowered by AutoResearch

entries.name: GigaWorld-Policy
entries.fullTitle: GigaWorld-Policy: An Efficient Action-Centered World–Action Model

entries.name: OmniVTA
entries.fullTitle: OmniVTA: Visuo-Tactile World Modeling for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation

entries.name: VAMPO
entries.fullTitle: VAMPO: Policy Optimization for Improving Visual Dynamics in Video Action Models

entries.name: DDP
entries.fullTitle: Dreaming the Unseen: World Model-regularized Diffusion Policy for Out-of-Distribution Robustness

entries.name: VTAM
entries.fullTitle: VTAM: Video-Tactile-Action Models for Complex Physical Interaction Beyond VLAs

entries.name: LaMP
entries.fullTitle: LaMP: Learning Vision-Language-Action Policy with 3D Scene Flow as Latent Motion Prior

entries.name: DriveDreamer-Policy
entries.fullTitle: DriveDreamer-Policy: A Geometry-Grounded World-Action Model for Unified Generation and Planning

entries.name: SpatialVAM
entries.fullTitle: SpatialVAM:Spatial-Aware Multi-View Video Diffusion as a Data-Efficient Robot Policy
entries.description: Jointly predicts spatial heatmap and RGB videos across multiple views, injecting 3D action structure into a video diffusion model for data-efficient robot manipulation.

entries.name: Veo-Act
entries.fullTitle: Veo-Act: How Far Can Frontier Video Models Advance Generalizable Robot Manipulation?

entries.name: GraspDreamer
entries.fullTitle: Grasp as You Dream: Imitating Functional Grasping from Generated Human Demonstrations

entries.name: VAG
entries.fullTitle: VAG: Dual-Stream Video-Action Generation for Embodied Data Synthesis

entries.name: WAV
entries.fullTitle: World-Value-Action Model: Implicit Planning for Vision-Language-Action Systems

entries.name: π₀.₇
entries.fullTitle: π₀.₇: a Steerable Generalist Robotic Foundation Model with Emergent Capabilities

entries.name: CKT-WAM
entries.fullTitle: CKT-WAM: Parameter-Efficient Context Knowledge Transfer Between World Action Models

entries.name: FFDC-WAM
entries.fullTitle: When to Trust Imagination: Adaptive Action Execution for World Action Models

entries.name: NoiseGate
entries.fullTitle: NoiseGate: Learning Per-Latent Timestep Schedules as Information Gating in World Action Models

entries.name: DreamAvoid
entries.fullTitle: DreamAvoid: Critical-Phase Test-Time Dreaming to Avoid Failures in VLA Policies

entries.name: CreFlow
entries.fullTitle: CreFlow: Corrective Reflow for Sparse-Reward Embodied Video Diffusion RL

entries.name: Pelican-Unify 1.0
entries.fullTitle: Pelican-Unify 1.0: A Unified Embodied Intelligence Model for Understanding, Reasoning, Imagination and Action

entries.name: HiMem-WAM
entries.fullTitle: HiMem-WAM: Hierarchical Memory-Gated World Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Combines motion-centric latent actions, high-level skill latents, and boundary-triggered memory updates for long-horizon manipulation.

entries.name: ω-EVA
entries.fullTitle: ω-EVA: Envision, Verify, and Act with Latent Interactive World Models
entries.description: Uses an Envision–Verify–Act loop to feed proposal-conditioned latent futures back into action generation without rendering future videos at inference.

entries.name: WAM-RL
entries.fullTitle: WAM-RL: World-Action Model Reinforcement Learning with Reconstruction Rewards and Online Video SFT
entries.description: Brings online reinforcement learning into the WAM loop, jointly improving the world model and actor for longer-horizon manipulation.

entries.name: LaST-HD
entries.fullTitle: LaST-HD: Learning Latent Physical Reasoning from Scalable Human Data for Robot Manipulation
entries.description: Aligns human-hand and robot demonstrations through an auxiliary action-conditioned world model, using shared forward-dynamics latents to transfer physical manipulation behavior across embodiments.

entries.name: ICWM
entries.fullTitle: In-Context World Modeling for Robotic Control
entries.description: Treats robot system identification as in-context world modeling, letting VLA policies infer camera and embodiment dynamics from short self-generated interaction histories.

entries.name: REGEN
entries.fullTitle: World Action Models Enable Continual Imitation Learning with Recurrent Generative Replays
entries.description: Uses WAM-generated pseudo-replay trajectories to reduce catastrophic forgetting during continual imitation learning without storing old demonstrations.

entries.name: MECo-WAM
entries.fullTitle: Learning 4D Geometric Priors for Inference-Efficient World Action Models
entries.description: Transfers action-relevant 4D geometry into a lightweight video-action pathway through auxiliary expert co-training and temporal geometric distillation.

entries.name: WAM-TTT
entries.fullTitle: WAM-TTT: Steering World-Action Models by Watching Human Play at Test Time
entries.description: Adapts a frozen WAM using unlabeled human videos and a lightweight test-time memory, without robot actions or task-specific fine-tuning.

entries.name: EgoWAM
entries.fullTitle: EgoWAM: World Action Models Beyond Pixels with In-the-Wild Egocentric Human Data
entries.description: Studies pixel, DINO, and 3D-flow world targets for human-to-robot transfer, showing the value of agent-invariant dynamics over appearance prediction alone.

entries.name: Temporal Ratio
entries.fullTitle: Understanding and Mitigating the Video-Action Generalization Gap via Temporal Ratio
entries.description: Measures how strongly an action head relies on future latent rollouts and uses the signal for inference-time guidance of compositional generalization.

entries.name: LingBot-VA 2.0
entries.fullTitle: Native Video-Action Pretraining for Generalizable Robot Control
entries.description: Builds a video-action foundation model natively for embodiment with semantic visual-action tokenization, causal pretraining, sparse MoE inference, and asynchronous closed-loop control.

entries.name: DexAC-WM
entries.fullTitle: Not All Actions Are Equal: Rethinking Conditioning for Dexterous World Model
entries.description: Adds dimension-aware action tokenization and semantic grounding for high-DoF dexterous world models, improving action fidelity beyond global action-sequence compression.

entries.name: MemoryWAM
entries.fullTitle: MemoryWAM: Efficient World Action Modeling with Persistent Memory
entries.description: Adds hybrid persistent memory to WAMs through recent frames, event-boundary anchors, and gist tokens for efficient long-horizon manipulation.

entries.name: ImageWAM
entries.fullTitle: ImageWAM: Do World Action Models Really Need Video Generation, or Just Image Editing?
entries.description: Recasts WAM inference as image-editing-conditioned action prediction, using denoising cache features as a compact world-action context instead of full future video rollout.

entries.name: Scaling Offline Model-Based RL via Jointly-Optimized World-Action Model Pretraining
entries.fullTitle: Scaling Offline Model-Based RL via Jointly-Optimized World-Action Model Pretraining
entries.description: Shows that jointly pretraining world and action models improves offline generalization, making world-action models useful beyond pure video prediction.

entries.name: DreamZero
entries.fullTitle: World Action Models are Zero-shot Policies
entries.description: One of the clearest recent WAM papers: jointly predicts future video and action, while demonstrating strong zero-shot transfer across tasks and embodiments.

entries.name: VLA-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: VLA-JEPA: Enhancing Vision-Language-Action Model with Latent World Model
entries.description: Adds a JEPA-style latent world model to VLA training, improving planning without decoding every future frame.

entries.name: GeoSem-WAM
entries.fullTitle: GeoSem-WAM: Geometry- and Semantic-Aware World Action Models
entries.description: Adds geometry and semantic prediction branches to WAM training, emphasizing representation learning benefits without requiring test-time video rollout.

entries.name: Dream-Tac
entries.fullTitle: Dream-Tac: A Unified Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
entries.description: Extends WAMs beyond vision by jointly modeling future tactile observations, future visual observations, and actions for contact-rich manipulation.

entries.name: Qwen-RobotWorld
entries.fullTitle: Qwen-RobotWorld Technical Report: Unifying Embodied World Modeling through Language-Conditioned Video Generation
entries.description: Uses language as a unified action interface to predict future visual trajectories across manipulation, driving, navigation, and human-to-robot transfer.

entries.name: GAM
entries.fullTitle: Geometric Action Model for Robot Policy Learning
