entries.description: Repurposes a geometric foundation model for perception, language-conditioned future latent prediction, and action decoding in robot policies.

entries.name: UMA
entries.fullTitle: Unified Motion-Action Modeling for Heterogeneous Robot Learning
entries.description: Treats 3D object motion and robot actions as co-evolving variables, supporting both dynamics modeling and visuomotor control from heterogeneous data.

entries.name: LingBot-VA
entries.fullTitle: Causal World Modeling for Robot Control
entries.description: LingBot-VA jointly models video and actions with a causal mixture-of-transformers architecture and autoregressive diffusion, integrating new observations during closed-loop robot control.

entries.name: WorldVLA
entries.fullTitle: WorldVLA: Towards Autoregressive Action World Model
entries.description: Autoregressive action-world-model formulation for robot policies.

entries.name: UWM
entries.fullTitle: Unified World Models: Coupling Video and Action Diffusion for Pretraining on Large Robotic Datasets
entries.description: Couples video diffusion and action diffusion during large-scale robot pretraining.

entries.name: UVA
entries.fullTitle: Unified Video Action Model
entries.description: Early unified video-action model that treats action generation and world prediction as one process.

entries.name: LDA-1B
entries.fullTitle: LDA-1B: Scaling Latent Dynamics Action Model via Universal Embodied Data Ingestion
entries.description: Scales latent dynamics action modeling with large embodied data ingestion.

entries.name: Motus
entries.fullTitle: Motus: A Unified Latent Action World Model
entries.description: Unifies latent action learning and future prediction for manipulation control.

entries.name: Ctrl-World
entries.fullTitle: Ctrl-World: A Controllable Generative World Model for Robot Manipulation
entries.description: Focuses on controllable manipulation world generation rather than passive video prediction.

entries.name: Flow-as-Action
entries.fullTitle: Latent Policy Steering with Embodiment-Agnostic Pretrained World Models
entries.description: Uses latent flow-like controls to steer pretrained world models across embodiments.

entries.name: MinD
entries.fullTitle: MinD: Learning A Dual-System World Model for Real-Time Planning and Implicit Risk Analysis
entries.description: Pairs a low-frequency visual diffusion model with a high-frequency action policy in an asynchronous dual-system design, aligning their latent predictions for real-time planning and anticipatory failure analysis.

entries.name: VideoVLA
entries.fullTitle: VideoVLA: Video Generators Can Be Generalizable Robot Manipulators
entries.description: Treats video generators as generalizable robot manipulators through action-conditioned prediction.

entries.name: VERA
entries.fullTitle: Turning Video Models into Generalist Robot Policies
entries.description: Decouples an action-free video world model from embodiment-specific inverse dynamics, showing another route to cross-embodiment robot control.

entries.name: AHEAD
entries.fullTitle: Intercepting the Future: Latent-Space Predictive World Model for Dynamic VLA Manipulation
entries.description: Adds latent predictive interception for dynamic manipulation, addressing VLA failures when objects move during execution latency.

entries.name: mimic-video
entries.fullTitle: mimic-video: Video-Action Models for Generalizable Robot Control Beyond VLAs
entries.description: A video-action modeling route for robot control that goes beyond direct VLA decoding.

entries.name: MotuBrain
entries.fullTitle: MotuBrain: An Advanced World Action Model for Robot Control
entries.description: A recent unified multimodal WAM that emphasizes multiple inference modes and real-time robot control deployment.

entries.name: GEM-4D
entries.fullTitle: GEM-4D: Geometry-Enhanced Video World Models for Robot Manipulation
entries.description: Supervises a video world model with dense 4D point correspondences distilled from a geometry model, then maps geometrically consistent predicted videos to executable robot trajectories with inverse dynamics.

entries.name: JOPAT
entries.fullTitle: Point Tracking Improves World Action Models
entries.description: Adds 2D point tracks and visibility to pixel-action prediction, improving long-horizon manipulation under occlusion.

entries.name: Action Images
entries.fullTitle: Action Images: End-to-End Policy Learning via Multiview Video Generation
entries.description: Represents robot actions directly as pixel-grounded multiview action images, reducing the gap between video modeling and control.

entries.name: Fast-WAM
entries.fullTitle: Fast-WAM: Do World Action Models Need Test-time Future Imagination?
entries.description: Important for teasing apart training-time world modeling from test-time imagination, while keeping real-time control practical.

entries.name: AIM
entries.fullTitle: AIM: Intent-Aware Unified world action Modeling with Spatial Value Maps
entries.description: Adds an explicit spatial-value interface between future prediction and action decoding, which makes the WAM formulation more control-oriented.

entries.name: X-WAM
entries.fullTitle: Unified 4D World Action Modeling from Video Priors with Asynchronous Denoising
entries.description: Unifies robot action execution with multi-view RGB-D future synthesis, making the 4D side of WAMs much more explicit.

entries.name: tau0-WM
entries.fullTitle: τ₀-WM: A Unified Video-Action World Model for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Integrates policy learning, video prediction, and action evaluation in one future-predictive manipulation model.

entries.name: WALL-WM
entries.fullTitle: WALL-WM: Carving World Action Modeling at the Event Joints
entries.description: Adds event-grounded language labels to world-action pretraining so generated futures align more tightly with behaviorally meaningful transitions.

entries.name: World Action Verifier
entries.fullTitle: World Action Verifier: Self-Improving World Models via Forward-Inverse Asymmetry
entries.description: Notable for using verification-style asymmetry to self-improve a world-action model rather than only scaling generation quality.

entries.name: Do World Action Models Generalize Better than VLAs?
entries.fullTitle: Do World Action Models Generalize Better than VLAs? A Robustness Study
entries.description: Empirical comparison of world-model-based action policies vs. direct VLA policies under distribution shift.

entries.name: DriveVLA-W0
entries.fullTitle: DriveVLA-W0: World Models Amplify Data Scaling Law in Autonomous Driving

entries.name: Seer
entries.fullTitle: Predictive Inverse Dynamics Models are Scalable Learners for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Canonical predict-then-act formulation: an end-to-end Predictive Inverse Dynamics Model forecasts future visual states and conditions action prediction on them, pretrained on large robot datasets such as DROID.

entries.name: SuSIE
entries.fullTitle: Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation with Pretrained Image-Editing Diffusion Models
entries.description: Fine-tunes InstructPix2Pix on human and robot video to hallucinate future subgoal observations from language commands, which a low-level goal-conditioned policy then reaches — the canonical subgoal-image predict-then-act paper.

entries.name: CLOVER
entries.fullTitle: Closed-Loop Visuomotor Control with Generative Expectation for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Generates text-conditioned video-diffusion visual plans as reference expectations and uses a measurable embedding space with a feedback-driven controller to close the loop on long-horizon manipulation.

entries.name: VidMan
entries.fullTitle: VidMan: Exploiting Implicit Dynamics from Video Diffusion Model for Effective Robot Manipulation
entries.description: Two-stage dual-process framework that first pretrains a video diffusion model on Open X-Embodiment to predict future visual trajectories, then adapts its implicit dynamics knowledge for action prediction.

entries.name: Moto
entries.fullTitle: Moto: Latent Motion Token as the Bridging Language for Learning Robot Manipulation from Videos
entries.description: Autoregressively pretrains Moto-GPT on hardware-agnostic latent motion tokens tokenized from video frame transitions, then co-fine-tunes for real robot control so motion priors from action-free video transfer to manipulation.

entries.name: LAPA
entries.fullTitle: Latent Action Pretraining from Videos
entries.description: Learns VQ-VAE discrete latent actions between video frames as a future-transition code, pretrains a latent VLA on internet videos without robot action labels, and fine-tunes on small robot datasets to ground latent to real actions.

entries.name: IGOR
entries.fullTitle: IGOR: Image-GOal Representations are the Atomic Control Units for Foundation Models in Embodied AI
entries.description: Compresses visual changes between an image and its goal state into a unified latent action space shared by humans and robots, enabling joint training of foundation policy and world models over internet-scale video.

entries.name: UniVLA
entries.fullTitle: UniVLA: Learning to Act Anywhere with Task-centric Latent Actions
entries.description: Derives task-centric latent actions from cross-embodiment videos with a latent action model built in DINO feature space, letting one generalist policy transfer across embodiments, perspectives, and environments.

entries.name: LAWM
entries.fullTitle: Latent Action Pretraining Through World Modeling
entries.description: Model-agnostic self-supervised framework that pretrains imitation policies by learning latent action representations from unlabeled robot and human video through world modeling, targeting deployable model sizes.

entries.name: Track2Act
entries.fullTitle: Track2Act: Predicting Point Tracks from Internet Videos enables Generalizable Robot Manipulation
entries.description: Predicts goal-conditioned future point tracks from web videos, infers object rigid transforms and end-effector poses from the predicted tracks, and refines execution with a residual policy for zero-shot manipulation.

entries.name: ATM
entries.fullTitle: Any-point Trajectory Modeling for Policy Learning
entries.description: Pretrains a trajectory model to predict future tracks of arbitrary points in a video frame from action-free demonstrations, then uses the predicted tracks as dense control guidance for visuomotor policies across 130+ tasks.

entries.name: GigaBrain-0
entries.fullTitle: GigaBrain-0: A World Model-Powered Vision-Language-Action Model
entries.description: VLA foundation model trained predominantly on world-model-generated data (video generation, real2real, human-transfer, view-transfer, and sim2real data), with RGBD input modeling and embodied chain-of-thought supervision; precursor to the already-listed GigaBrain-0.5M.

entries.name: WMPO
entries.fullTitle: WMPO: World Model-based Policy Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models
entries.description: Runs on-policy GRPO for VLA policies entirely inside a pixel-based action-conditioned world model whose imagined trajectories align with web-pretrained VLA features, enabling self-improvement without physical rollouts.

entries.name: Hydra-0
entries.fullTitle: Hydra-0: Action Flow for Generalist World Modeling and Control
entries.description: NVIDIA Isaac generalist world model conditioned on action flow (robot actions as pixel motion), reporting r=0.96 policy-evaluation correlation on RoboLab and an emergent inverse mode that maps desired object flow from human demos to executable robot motion.

entries.name: LD4WAM
entries.fullTitle: LD4WAM: Learning Latent Dynamics from Human Videos for World Action Models
entries.description: Pairs a motion-aligned latent dynamics model trained on human videos with a mixture-of-transformers world-dynamics action model that distills embodiment-agnostic latent dynamics from generated futures into robot actions.

entries.name: WAM-OPD
entries.fullTitle: WAM-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for World Action Models
entries.description: Deployment-consistent post-training in which a frozen WAM teacher labels student-visited histories with coherent video and action targets, repairing accelerated students without sparse-reward RL on RoboTwin 2.0.

entries.name: WM-Policy vs. Imitated WAM Separation
entries.fullTitle: On the Capability Separation Between World-Model Policy Learning and Imitated World-Action Models
entries.description: Proves that imitation-trained world-action policies collapse to the observational behavior policy under realizability, formally separating them from policies optimized against an action-conditioned world model.

entries.name: DELE-w0.5
entries.fullTitle: DELE-w0.5: Inferring Action from Future Latent State for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Argues video generation is an unnecessary intermediate for world-action modeling and infers action sequences from compact predicted future end states rather than dense frame-by-frame rollouts.

entries.name: ForeTime-VLA
entries.fullTitle: ForeTime-VLA: Causal Future-Token Distillation from a World Action Model for Conveyor-Belt Manipulation
entries.description: Distills a future-aware, action-equivalent representation from a frozen Fast-WAM teacher into a dense pi0.5 policy that stays causal at inference, targeting moving-object manipulation on conveyor belts.

entries.name: Surgical Visual-Trajectory WAM
entries.fullTitle: Towards Surgical World-Action Modeling: A Preliminary Joint Visual-Trajectory Forecasting for Surgical Motion Planning
entries.description: Jointly forecasts future surgical scenes and instrument trajectories in one world-action model so predicted motion can be evaluated at the trajectory level while remaining consistent with visual scene evolution.

entries.name: HiTac-WAM
entries.fullTitle: HiTac-WAM: A Hierarchical Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
entries.description: Forecasts future tactile states factorized into a contact-state → 3D-deformation-field → slip-risk hierarchy for each candidate action chunk and ranks candidates by their tactile forecasts before execution.

entries.name: Foresight Without Seeing (ForeWAM)
entries.fullTitle: Foresight Without Seeing: Latent Futures for World Action Models
entries.description: Dynamics-conditioned direct-policy WAM whose Future-KV performs a single Video-DiT prefill over the current latent and stochastic future slots, exposing predictive context to the action DiT without decoding future videos.

entries.name: RIFT
entries.fullTitle: Keep the Future, Drop the Rollout: RIFT for World Action Models
entries.description: Closed-loop interventions on 40 LIBERO tasks show some WAMs can reuse a fixed final-clean KV cache with ~98% success, motivating rollout-free imagination that keeps future representations while dropping iterative video denoising.

entries.name: StageWAM
entries.fullTitle: StageWAM: Joint-Embedding Stage Prediction for World-Action Models in Robot Manipulation
entries.description: Augments a Motus-based WAM with a goal-conditioned Stage-JEPA predictor over frozen V-JEPA2 features, adding a stage-level semantic future on top of the short-term physical video-action future.

entries.name: HarnessWAM
entries.fullTitle: HarnessWAM: Bridging Prediction and Deliberation in World Action Models
entries.description: Agentic framework wrapping WAMs with a VLM task manager that maintains scene beliefs and task graphs, projecting open-ended plans into atomic-skill sequences within the WAM's capability boundary to close the prediction-deliberation gap.

entries.name: TempoWAM
entries.fullTitle: Rethink Before You Execute: Adaptive Execution for World Action Models
entries.description: Plug-and-play execution scheme that monitors task progress online and adaptively decides when a WAM should replan, replacing the fixed action-chunk execution horizon with progress-calibrated timing.

entries.name: SLIM-0.5B
entries.fullTitle: SLIM-0.5B: Learning Action-Grounded Predictive Latents for Robot Manipulation
entries.description: Compact 0.5B latent interaction policy that learns action-grounded predictive latents via self-supervised masked trajectory prediction, capturing both action-conditioned transitions and inverse-dynamics structure.

entries.name: World Tokens
entries.fullTitle: World Tokens: Enhancing Embodied Policies with Training-Time World Modeling
entries.description: A World Adapter transforms VLM features into a fixed set of world tokens that condition a jointly fine-tuned future-video denoiser during training only, keeping deployment as cheap as a plain VLA.

entries.name: JEPA-WAM
entries.fullTitle: JEPA-WAM: Learning Vision-Language-Action Policies with Joint-Embedding World Modeling
entries.description: Latent WAM built in pretrained V-JEPA space that couples latent transition prediction and continuous action generation through a shared predictor over a spatially structured joint current-future target.

entries.name: Flex-π
entries.fullTitle: Flex-π: A Multi-Stream World-Action Model with Compute Flexibility
entries.description: Shows a frozen video VAE also encodes 3D pointmaps almost losslessly, letting a 6B mixture-of-transformers WAM jointly denoise RGB, geometry, DINO semantics, and actions, with per-stream dropout enabling anything from action-only to full-generation inference.

entries.name: SG-WAM (semantic guidance)
entries.fullTitle: SG-WAM: Text-Grounded and Spatial-aware Semantic Guidance for World-Action Models
entries.description: Uses a VLM-based semantic planner to produce text-grounded and spatial-aware semantic foresight, correcting instruction-video misalignment in WAM future prediction and downstream actions.

entries.name: Vid2WAM
entries.fullTitle: Vid2WAM: Distilling Video Diffusion Priors into World Action Models
entries.description: Offline distillation that supervises a compact WAM student with task-conditioned future rollouts from a large video foundation model plus inverse-dynamics pseudo-actions, reducing dependence on expert robot demonstrations.

entries.name: 4D-WAM (trajectory fields)
entries.fullTitle: 4D-WAM: Infusing Spatiotemporal Awareness into World Action Models through Trajectory Fields
entries.description: Model-agnostic training strategy that aligns WAM representations with 3D trajectory fields through motion alignment and destination alignment objectives, closing the 2D-pixel vs. 3D-action representation gap.

entries.name: FACT
entries.fullTitle: FACT: Failure-Aware Causal Training for World-Action Models
entries.description: Causal WAM that predicts future video and task progress conditioned on the executed action, so failure rollouts become valid supervision for action consequences instead of being discarded.

entries.name: PILOT
entries.fullTitle: Decoupling Intention from Trajectory: A Representational Deduction Framework for World Action Models
entries.description: Disentangles high-level physical condition evolution from low-level trajectory generation via representational deduction with motion chain-of-thought guidance inside the action model.

entries.name: WA-SpecDec
entries.fullTitle: WA-SpecDec: World-Aware Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language-Action Models
entries.description: Injects world-model-derived scene awareness into speculative decoding for VLAs, adapting the token-acceptance tolerance to physical risk so free-space and near-contact deviations are treated differently.

entries.name: GWM-VLA
entries.fullTitle: GWM-VLA: Geometry-Aware Latent World Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Learning
entries.description: Aggregates multi-view observations into geometry-aware states with VGGT-Ω and predicts next-step target-view patch tokens under shared latent-action representations grounded by robot-action supervision.

entries.name: LAWM-3D
entries.fullTitle: LAWM-3D: Learning 3D-Aware Latent Actions from Human Videos for Generalizable Robot World Models
entries.description: Shows naive multi-view training does not make latent action models 3D-aware due to appearance leakage and inter-camera discrepancies, and proposes fixes for learning 3D-aware latent actions from human videos.

entries.name: JoyAI-RA 0.5
entries.fullTitle: JoyAI-RA 0.5: Scaling Robot Manipulation Learning via Dual Action Alignment
entries.description: Vision-Language-World-Action framework whose implicit alignment infers latent actions from visual transitions to teach a latent-action-conditioned world model from human, sim, and robot data, while explicit alignment grounds trajectories in a unified action space.

entries.name: DreamWAM
entries.fullTitle: DreamWAM: Beyond RGB Future Prediction for World Action Models
entries.description: Reformulates WAM future prediction as structured world modeling across appearance, motion, geometry, and semantics, combining joint RGB-motion latent denoising with gated residual geometry/semantics branches.

entries.name: MobileWAM
entries.fullTitle: MobileWAM: Bridging World Action Models to Mobile Manipulation with Chain-of-Foresight
entries.description: Extends video-backbone WAMs beyond tabletop settings with a three-expert (shared/locomotion/manipulation) action mixture routed by motion intent and chain-of-foresight supervision for whole-body mobile manipulation.

entries.name: Faster-WAM (future conditioning)
entries.fullTitle: Faster-WAM: Efficient Inference-Time Future Conditioning for Robust World Action Models
entries.description: Shows inference-time future conditioning is critical for WAM robustness under distribution shift and preserves it cheaply by computing future representations once and sparsely reusing them.

entries.name: LiLa-WAM
entries.fullTitle: LiLa-WAM: Lightweight Latent Reasoning World-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: End-to-end-trainable WAM that reasons about the future in a compact latent space jointly shaped by future-state prediction and action generation, fitting training on a single 24GB GPU.

entries.name: Faster-WAM (DoT)
entries.fullTitle: Faster-WAM: Do World Action Models Need Deep Action Modules?
entries.description: Dock-of-Transformer design that treats a pretrained 30-layer video transformer as a representation hub and docks a single-layer action head onto it, decoupling action-module depth from video-backbone depth. (Same name as 2608.04404 but a different paper.)

entries.name: CoWAM
entries.fullTitle: CoWAM: Coordination Contracts for Selective Policy Intervention with WAMs
entries.description: Selective intervention layer for bimanual policies that expresses synchronization, role compatibility, and collision convergence as typed coordination contracts checked against WAM-predicted futures before overriding nominal actions.

entries.name: Async WAM Deployment
entries.fullTitle: World Action Models in Real Time: An Empirical Study of Smooth Execution via Asynchronous Deployment
entries.description: Compares six asynchronous execution strategies for latency-heavy WAM inference on a 10 Hz bimanual robot, identifying temporal alignment between observations, predictions, and executed commands as the key requirement.

entries.name: SG-WAM (self-guided)
entries.fullTitle: SG-WAM: Self-Guided World Modeling in Geometry-Aware Policy Space
entries.description: Learns geometry-aware action-conditioned dynamics directly in policy-derived representation space with learnable dynamics tokens and EMA-generated prediction targets. (Same acronym as 2608.08839 but a different paper.)

entries.name: DynamicWAM
entries.fullTitle: DynamicWAM: Dual-Path Motion Conditioning for World-Action Models in Dynamic Manipulation
entries.description: Compact WAM for moving-object manipulation that fuses history-flow conditioning through a frozen video VAE with kinematic descriptors in the action expert, deployed with real-time-chunking asynchronous execution.

entries.name: SelfWAM
entries.fullTitle: SelfWAM: A Self-Grounded Unified World Action Model for Fast Robot Control
entries.description: Mixture-of-transformers WAM that jointly predicts actions, action-conditioned future frames, and robot self-masks, grounding future prediction in the robot's visible body while keeping a fast action-only inference path.

entries.name: OVTF
entries.fullTitle: Disentangling Visuo-Tactile Foresight: Oracle-Guided Interface Discovery for World Action Models
entries.description: Controlled oracle framework supplying verified paired RGB and tactile futures to isolate how visuo-tactile foresight should be structured at the future-to-action interface of tactile WAMs.

entries.name: SCVC
entries.fullTitle: Selective Cross-View Consistency for World Action Models: Held-Out Viewpoint Robustness Without Test-Time Camera Information
entries.description: Proves consistency losses on view-covariant WAM outputs shrink legitimate view-specific content, and constrains only the view-invariant action/proprioception/value block for held-out viewpoint robustness.

entries.name: FBFM
entries.fullTitle: FBFM: A Training-Free Asynchronous Feedback Mechanism for Flow-Matching in World-Action Models Execution
entries.description: Pushes observation re-grounding inside actively generated WAM action chunks via masked pseudoinverse corrections to the flow-matching velocity field, correcting prediction error at individual time steps.

entries.name: ST-WAM
entries.fullTitle: ST-WAM: Semantic-Temporal World Action Model for Robust Manipulation under Visual Distribution Shifts
entries.description: Identifies training-distribution hallucination in pixel-supervised WAMs under visual shift and switches future supervision to DINOv3 semantic features that better preserve task-state distinctions.

entries.name: QuantWAMs
entries.fullTitle: QuantWAMs: Calibrating at the Right Granularity for World Action Models
entries.description: Post-training quantization framework tailored to WAMs, with shared-basis outlier calibration, joint video-action Fisher saliency for precision assignment, and fixed-intervention closed-loop calibration.

entries.name: TacWAM
entries.fullTitle: TacWAM: Anchor-Guided World Action Model with Mechanics-Aware Tactile Prediction
entries.description: Maps tactile appearance, dense force fields, and deformation flow into a shared latent prediction space with force/torque reconstruction, keeping tactile futures physically meaningful without becoming privileged action cues.

entries.name: DC-WAM
entries.fullTitle: DC-WAM: Dynamic-Centric Visual Supervision and Reasoning for World-Action Models
entries.description: Redirects RGB-based WAM future prediction from appearance-dominated reconstruction toward interaction-induced visual dynamics without adding modality-specific predictions or extra deployment inputs.

entries.name: LeapBot-WA
entries.fullTitle: LeapBot-WA: World-Anchor Action Models via Predictive Latent Alignments
entries.description: Operationalizes JEPA as a world anchor for WAMs, replacing pixel synthesis with predictive semantic alignment and an isotropic semantic autoencoder that bridges predictive features and diffusion priors.

entries.name: N0-TWAM
entries.fullTitle: N0-TWAM: Scaling Tactile-Native World-Action Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation
entries.description: First large-scale tactile-native WAM, pretrained with visuo-tactile joint training across six embodiments and 450 tasks using the unified NeoForce contact representation and tactile contact events for task staging.

entries.name: WorldDiT
entries.fullTitle: WorldDiT: A Unified Diffusion Architecture for World and Action Modeling
entries.description: Sub-billion-parameter diffusion transformer that generates continuous action chunks while predicting normalized future RGB patch targets, sitting on the parameter-vs-success Pareto frontier across four LIBERO suites without a VLM backbone.

entries.name: ContactFlow
entries.fullTitle: ContactFlow: A Video Action Conditioning that Transfers Across Embodiments
entries.description: Encodes manipulation as trajectories of 3D contact points between actor and object, giving human and robot interaction videos a shared embodiment-agnostic conditioning signal for a large video world model.

entries.name: Enfold
entries.fullTitle: Enfold: Folding World Model Imagination into Predictive Representations for Ultra-Efficient Embodied Control
entries.description: Internalizes the future-generative computation of a video world model into a representation predicted from the present alone, supervised by the generator's multi-level intermediate states during training.

entries.name: WCM (World Critic Model)
entries.fullTitle: WCM: A World Critic Model for Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Learning
entries.description: Adds an explicit world-modeling objective to the critic in VLA reinforcement learning so value estimation captures cross-temporal dynamics under partial observability instead of single-frame state approximations.

entries.name: τ0-VLA
entries.fullTitle: τ₀-VLA: a Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with World-Model-Guided Test-Time Computation
entries.description: Hierarchical robot foundation model trained on 40,115 hours of real-world data whose high-level policy searches over alternative subtasks with world-model guidance before committing, scaling test-time compute on consequential decisions.

entries.name: DreamTrajectory
entries.fullTitle: DreamTrajectory: Trajectory-Guided Action Generation with World Model Alignment for Mobile Manipulation
entries.description: Adds an explicit task-space motion plan for coordinated base-arm prediction and a world-model alignment check that verifies predicted action chunks will realize the intended motion before execution.

entries.name: Robust-WAM
entries.fullTitle: Robust-WAM: Bridging Generative Pretraining and Semantic Foresight in World-Action Models
entries.description: Post-training method that keeps the VAE-based generative path of video-pretrained WAMs while adding a lightweight semantic-foresight alignment objective on the action stream for appearance-shift robustness.

entries.name: ContactGuard
entries.fullTitle: ContactGuard: Pre-Contact Execution Monitoring with Action-Conditioned Latent World Models
entries.description: Predicts the short-horizon latent consequence of a chunked policy's planned actions from unlabeled trajectories and aborts before contact when a lightweight probe flags likely failure in wrist-camera manipulation.

entries.name: FoMo-FD
entries.fullTitle: Failure Detection for Surgical Robot Imitation Policies via Flow-Matching World Modeling
entries.description: Learns nominal short-horizon visual dynamics with an action-conditioned flow-matching world model and scores inverse-transport nonconformity of observed latents to detect surgical policy failures without failure demonstrations.

entries.name: Surgical WAM
entries.fullTitle: Surgical WAM: A World-Action Model for Data-Efficient Surgical Robot Learning
entries.description: Tests whether action-free endoscopic video pretraining of a surgical world model improves closed-loop dVRK manipulation under a fixed budget of action-labeled demonstrations.

entries.name: Geometric Test-Time Scaling for WAMs
entries.fullTitle: Test-Time Scaling for World Action Models via Zero-Shot Geometric Evaluation
entries.description: Training-free selective Best-of-N framework that ranks sampled WAM rollouts by cross-view depth-reprojection consistency of predicted futures, gated by an action-future consistency check on RoboCasa, LIBERO-Long, and RoboTwin 2.0.

entries.name: WA-LQR
entries.fullTitle: Steering Robustness into World Action Models via Mechanistic Interpretability and Optimal Control
entries.description: Finds robustness-critical features are linearly separable in some WAM activation spaces and exploits local linearity for training-free contrastive steering plus a reduced-order LQR feedback controller.

entries.name: WorldScape Policy 2.0
entries.fullTitle: WorldScape Policy 2.0: Empowering Steerable World Action Modeling with Reasoning-Augmented Memory
entries.description: Controllable WAM with causal short-term visual memory as DiT prefill and long short-term event memory over VLM outputs for progress-aware retrieval and fine-grained language-video-action grounding.

entries.name: ShadowDancer
entries.fullTitle: ShadowDancer: Teaching Video World Models Any Action by Learning Unified Dynamics Representations from a Video and Its Shadow
entries.description: Achieves any-action frame-level control of video world models by training on shadow pairs — video pairs replaying the same dynamics under independently resampled appearance — so demonstration-specified dynamics transfer to new scenes.

entries.name: PhyAI
entries.fullTitle: PhyAI: Real-Time Physical AI at the Edge, Scalable Rollouts in the Cloud
entries.description: Unified inference engine that serves VLA models and WAMs from one runtime across onboard, edge, and cloud deployments, reporting 1.40-4.65x speedups over official implementations of pi0, pi0.5, and GR00T N1.7.

entries.name: WristWorld
entries.fullTitle: WristWorld: Generating Wrist-Views via 4D World Models for Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Reconstructs 4D geometry from anchor views and generates temporally coherent wrist-view videos for manipulation-policy training.

entries.name: EMMA
entries.fullTitle: EMMA: Generalizing Real-World Robot Manipulation via Generative Visual Transfer
entries.description: Generates geometrically consistent multi-view manipulation video variations to improve visual transfer of robot policies.

entries.name: EmbodieDreamer
entries.fullTitle: EmbodieDreamer: Advancing Real2Sim2Real Transfer for Policy Training via Embodied World Modeling
entries.description: Aligns simulated physics with real robot dynamics and translates simulation renderings into realistic policy-training videos.

entries.name: PIN-WM
entries.fullTitle: PIN-WM: Learning Physics-INformed World Models for Non-Prehensile Manipulation
entries.description: Identifies rigid-body dynamics from visual interactions with differentiable physics and builds randomized digital cousins for robust manipulation.

entries.name: PhysTwin
entries.fullTitle: PhysTwin: Physics-Informed Reconstruction and Simulation of Deformable Objects from Videos
entries.description: Reconstructs deformable digital twins with spring-mass dynamics and Gaussian rendering for novel-interaction simulation and robot planning.

entries.name: DexSim2Real²
entries.fullTitle: DexSim2Real²: Building Explicit World Model for Precise Articulated Object Dexterous Manipulation
entries.description: Builds explicit articulated-object digital twins through active interactions and uses model-predictive control for dexterous manipulation.

entries.name: Physically Embodied Gaussian Splatting
entries.fullTitle: Physically Embodied Gaussian Splatting: A Realtime Correctable World Model for Robotics
entries.description: Couples Gaussian rendering and particle physics to predict physical scene evolution and correct the model from live visual observations.

entries.name: Agentic Real2Sim
entries.fullTitle: Agentic Real2Sim: Physics-based World Modeling with Vision-Language Agents
entries.description: Uses vision-language agents to convert recordings of real robot-object interactions into simulation-ready episodic twins containing geometry, physical parameters, object states, cameras, poses, and interaction trajectories.

entries.name: RoboInter1.5
entries.fullTitle: RoboInter1.5: A Holistic Intermediate Representation Suite for Embodied World Modeling and Robotic Manipulation
entries.description: Unified suite of data, benchmarks, VLM/VLA models, and dense manipulation-oriented intermediate representations. RoboInter-World uses these structured signals to condition controllable prediction of future physical-world states.

entries.name: RialTo
entries.fullTitle: Reconciling Reality through Simulation: A Real-to-Sim-to-Real Approach for Robust Manipulation
entries.description: Robustifies real-world imitation policies by scanning scenes into on-the-fly digital-twin simulations, running reinforcement learning inside them, and transferring back with an inverse-distillation procedure.

entries.name: ACDC (Digital Cousins)
entries.fullTitle: Automated Creation of Digital Cousins for Robust Policy Learning
entries.description: Automatically converts a single real image into "digital cousin" simulation scenes that preserve geometric and semantic affordances without exact twin modeling, improving sim-to-real robustness over digital twins.

entries.name: URDFormer
entries.fullTitle: URDFormer: A Pipeline for Constructing Articulated Simulation Environments from Real-World Images
entries.description: Infers articulated URDF scene and object structure directly from single real-world images, providing a scalable pipeline from photos to simulation-ready interactive environments with kinematic structure.

entries.name: Real2Render2Real
entries.fullTitle: Real2Render2Real: Scaling Robot Data Without Dynamics Simulation or Robot Hardware
entries.description: Renders thousands of high-fidelity robot-agnostic demonstrations from one smartphone object scan and one human video by reconstructing 3DGS assets and tracking 6-DoF object motion, with no dynamics simulation or robot hardware.

entries.name: X-Sim
entries.fullTitle: X-Sim: Cross-Embodiment Learning via Real-to-Sim-to-Real
entries.description: Reconstructs photorealistic simulation from RGBD human video, trains RL policies with object-centric rewards as a dense cross-embodiment signal, and distills them into image-conditioned diffusion policies with online domain adaptation.

entries.name: PhysWorld
entries.fullTitle: PhysWorld: From Real Videos to World Models of Deformable Objects via Physics-Aware Demonstration Synthesis
entries.description: Builds physics-consistent MPM digital twins of deformable objects from limited real video via constitutive-model selection and global-to-local property optimization, then synthesizes diverse perturbed demonstrations to train efficient dynamics world models.

entries.name: Video2DoorTraversal
entries.fullTitle: Video2DoorTraversal: Push Door Traversal via Simulated Door Twins
entries.description: Single-video real-to-sim-to-real framework that reconstructs an instance-aligned articulated door twin, refines parameterized skill programs with a simulation-in-the-loop agent, and trains the ArticuACT base-arm-gripper policy for onboard wheel-legged door traversal.

entries.name: Torque-Level Real2Sim2Real
entries.fullTitle: Enhancing Sim2Real Transfer for Torque-Controlled Robots through Real2Sim Dynamics Estimation and Reinforcement Learning
entries.description: Identifies friction, inertia, and gravity-compensation parameters of a 7-DOF Franka Panda by trajectory matching with genetic-algorithm optimization, then trains TQC reinforcement-learning policies on the calibrated dynamics for torque-level Sim2Real transfer.

entries.name: GCA
entries.fullTitle: Learning Implicit Constitutive Laws for Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting from Monocular Videos
entries.description: Learns implicit constitutive laws of deformable objects represented as dynamic 3D Gaussians from a single fixed-viewpoint video, using rank-based depth-geometric anchors and LoRA adaptation to keep physical dynamics recovery stable in the monocular setting.

entries.name: R2S-EGO
entries.fullTitle: R2S-EGO: Dual-Proxy Refinement for Sparse-Capture Real-to-Sim
entries.description: Couples a simulator-derived robot proxy defining behavior-scoped executable view queries with a capture-anchored geometry proxy, assimilating camera-controlled synthesized views as pseudo-observations to refine real-to-sim visual assets from sparse human captures.

entries.name: RORA
entries.fullTitle: RORA: Realistic Object Reconstruction with Articulation
entries.description: First end-to-end pipeline that reconstructs simulation-ready assets with accurate multi-joint articulation from a single static object video, exporting a hybrid 3DGS-plus-mesh representation via a suggestion-based human-in-the-loop process.

entries.name: Sling2Sim2Real
entries.fullTitle: Sling2Sim2Real: One-Shot Elastic System Identification for Non-Destructive Slingshot Policy Learning
entries.description: One-shot Real2Sim2Real framework that identifies elastic object parameters from a single non-destructive interaction, enabling large-scale safe policy learning in simulation for slingshot-style elastic object manipulation.

entries.name: TableVerse
entries.fullTitle: TableVerse: A Large-scale Tabletop Dataset with Real-world Grounded Layouts for Generalizable Manipulation
entries.description: Fully automated Real2Sim pipeline that deterministically reconstructs simulation-ready cluttered tabletop environments with metric scale and verified mechanical stability from unstructured internet images, plus task-conditioned trajectory generation.

entries.name: World Translation
entries.fullTitle: World Translation: Minimizing Sim-to-Real Gap with Backward Dynamics Extraction and Unpaired Domain Translation
entries.description: Combines deterministic-but-imperfect simulators with learned real-world dynamics via backward dynamics extraction and unpaired domain translation, addressing partial-observability failures of learned real-to-sim dynamics such as sudden unheralded contact events.

entries.name: Valerant
entries.fullTitle: Valerant: An Automatic Navigable Game Map Generator via Action-Conditioned World Model Exploration
entries.description: Combines action-conditioned visual rollouts, SLAM reconstruction, and exploration-driven action selection to build a persistent, navigable 3D game map from one image.

entries.name: TourPhysics
entries.fullTitle: TourPhysics: Bringing Physics to World Models for Exploration and Manipulation from a Single Image
entries.description: Combines deterministic physics, camera trajectories, and geometry-indexed appearance memory with video generation for persistent exploration and object manipulation initialized from a single image.

entries.name: SpatialCrafter
entries.fullTitle: SpatialCrafter: Single Image World Modeling with Generative 3D Proxies
entries.description: Generates a globally aligned 3D scene proxy from one image, then uses geometry-conditioned video refinement to preserve scene structure under large viewpoint changes and revisits.

entries.name: TRELLISWorld
entries.fullTitle: TRELLISWorld: Training-Free World Generation from Object Generators
entries.description: Composes overlapping 3D object-generator tiles into large editable scenes with local semantic control.

entries.name: Terra
entries.fullTitle: Terra: Explorable Native 3D World Model with Point Latents
entries.description: Generates point-based 3D latent worlds that decode to Gaussians and expand progressively for coherent exploration.

entries.name: Thinking with Camera
entries.fullTitle: Thinking with Camera: A Unified Multimodal Model for Camera-Centric Understanding and Generation
entries.description: Unifies camera-conditioned understanding and generation to support cross-view spatial imagination and scene exploration.

entries.name: EvoWorld
entries.fullTitle: EvoWorld: Evolving Panoramic World Generation with Explicit 3D Memory
entries.description: Maintains evolving explicit 3D memory to guide panoramic video prediction and long-horizon scene exploration.

entries.name: Martian World Model
entries.fullTitle: Martian World Model: Controllable Video Synthesis with Physically Accurate 3D Reconstructions
entries.description: Reconstructs Martian terrain from rover stereo imagery and generates geometrically grounded camera-controlled videos for simulation.

entries.name: VMem
entries.fullTitle: VMem: Consistent Interactive Video Scene Generation with Surfel-Indexed View Memory
entries.description: Indexes past views by 3D surfels to retrieve geometric memory for consistent camera-controlled scene exploration.

entries.name: UrbanWorld
entries.fullTitle: UrbanWorld: An Urban World Model for 3D City Generation
entries.description: Builds controllable 3D urban environments from map layouts, generative assets, and language-guided refinement for agent navigation.

entries.name: MagicDrive3D
entries.fullTitle: MagicDrive3D: Controllable 3D Generation for Any-View Rendering in Street Scenes
entries.description: Combines controllable driving-view generation with Gaussian scene construction for any-view rendering of 3D street environments.

entries.name: ABot-3DWorld 0
entries.fullTitle: ABot-3DWorld 0: A Universal World Model to Explore Any 3D Space

entries.name: EmerNeRF
entries.fullTitle: EmerNeRF: Emergent Spatial-Temporal Scene Decomposition via Self-Supervision

entries.name: 4D Gaussian Splatting
entries.fullTitle: 4D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Dynamic Scene Rendering

entries.name: HunyuanWorld 1.0
entries.fullTitle: HunyuanWorld 1.0: Generating Immersive, Explorable, and Interactive 3D Worlds from Words or Pixels
entries.description: Text/image-to-3D immersive world generation with mesh-based explorable environments.

entries.name: HY-World 2.0
entries.fullTitle: HY-World 2.0: A Multi-Modal World Model for Reconstructing, Generating, and Simulating 3D Worlds
entries.description: A 2026 update spanning reconstruction, generation, and simulation in one 3D world stack.

entries.name: GeoWorld
entries.fullTitle: GeoWorld: Geometric World Models
entries.description: Geometry-first world modeling that sharpens the spatial side of general world-model research.

entries.name: MRO-GWM
entries.fullTitle: Learning Action-Conditional and Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting World Models for Rigid Objects
entries.description: Object-centric Gaussian world model for rigid-object dynamics under actions, useful for contact-aware manipulation and simulation.

entries.name: WorldAct
entries.fullTitle: WorldAct: Activating Monolithic 3D Worlds into Interactive-Ready Object-Centric Scenes
entries.description: Converts static generated 3D worlds into object-centric, editable, collision-aware scenes for interaction and embodied simulation.

entries.name: Matrix-3D
entries.fullTitle: Matrix-3D: Omnidirectional Explorable 3D World Generation
entries.description: 360° navigable 3D world generation from a single image or text prompt.

entries.name: WorldGrow
entries.fullTitle: WorldGrow: Generating Infinite 3D World
entries.description: Infinite 3D world generation, complementing bounded explorable-scene models.

entries.name: FantasyWorld
entries.fullTitle: FantasyWorld: Geometry-Consistent World Modeling via Unified Video and 3D Prediction
entries.description: Unifies video and 3D prediction to improve geometry consistency.

entries.name: Aether
entries.fullTitle: Aether: Geometric-Aware Unified World Modeling
entries.description: Geometry-aware unified world modeling for spatially consistent generation.

entries.name: WonderWorld
entries.fullTitle: WonderWorld: Interactive 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image
entries.description: Single-image interactive 3D scene generation, useful as an early 3D world-model baseline.

entries.name: DreamAnywhere
entries.fullTitle: DreamAnywhere: Object-Centric Panoramic 3D Scene Generation
entries.description: Maintains an object-decomposed scene state — individually lifted 3D assets over an inpainted background — from a single panorama, and uses it to support both free navigation and object-level scene editing, making the generated world revisitable and modifiable rather than a one-shot render.

entries.name: SceneScape
entries.fullTitle: SceneScape: Text-Driven Consistent Scene Generation
entries.description: Maintains a progressively accumulated scene mesh across generation steps, uses it to render already-committed geometry and synthesize only newly disoccluded regions under a camera trajectory, enabling geometrically consistent perpetual scene rollout.

entries.name: WorldGen
entries.fullTitle: WorldGen: From Text to Traversable and Interactive 3D Worlds
entries.description: Plans a world layout with an LLM, constrains generation to a navigation mesh so the resulting scene stays traversable, and decomposes it into object-aware assets, producing navigable, editable 3D environments loadable in standard game engines.

entries.name: LayerPano3D
entries.fullTitle: LayerPano3D: Layered 3D Panorama for Hyper-Immersive Scene Generation
entries.description: Maintains a layered 3D Gaussian scene state lifted from a generated panorama, with occluded content stored behind foreground layers, so viewpoint changes during free in-scene walking render coherent geometry — a persistent navigable world rather than fixed-viewpoint panorama viewing.

entries.name: WonderJourney
entries.fullTitle: WonderJourney: Going from Anywhere to Everywhere
entries.description: Conditions each newly generated 3D scene on the current scene's image and lifted point-cloud geometry plus a textual history of visited scenes (rather than one accumulated persistent point cloud), with LLM-scripted scene descriptions and VLM verification that regenerates failed scenes, enabling extended scene-to-scene rollout with automated repair.

entries.name: Holodeck
entries.fullTitle: Holodeck: Language Guided Generation of 3D Embodied AI Environments
entries.description: Generates fully populated, executable AI2-THOR environments from language via LLM-proposed spatial-relational constraints and asset retrieval, and the resulting scenes are directly used to train and evaluate embodied navigation agents.

entries.name: PanoWorld-X
entries.fullTitle: PanoWorld-X: Generating Explorable Panoramic Worlds via Sphere-Aware Video Diffusion
entries.description: Generates explorable panoramic worlds with sphere-aware video diffusion, evolving the 360° scene under user-specified camera routes for free exploration.

entries.name: OmniRoam
entries.fullTitle: OmniRoam: World Wandering via Long-Horizon Panoramic Video Generation
entries.description: Targets long-horizon panoramic world wandering, rolling a 360° scene forward under trajectory control for extended camera-conditioned exploration.

entries.name: InfiniteNature-Zero
entries.fullTitle: InfiniteNature-Zero: Learning Perpetual View Generation of Natural Scenes from Single Images
entries.description: Learns perpetual view generation from single photos with a render-refine-repeat loop, evolving scene geometry frame-to-frame under a camera trajectory for unbounded flythrough rollout.

entries.name: World Labs (Marble)
entries.fullTitle: Marble: A Multimodal World Model
entries.description: Fei-Fei Li's startup; text- and image-driven 3D world generation with explorable geometry and depth.

entries.name: HOLODECK 2.0
entries.fullTitle: HOLODECK 2.0: Vision-Language-Guided 3D World Generation with Editing
entries.description: Follow-up to the listed Holodeck: open-domain 3D scene generation with vision-language-guided flexible editing.

entries.name: LatticeWorld
entries.fullTitle: LatticeWorld: A Multimodal Large Language Model-Empowered Framework for Interactive Complex World Generation
entries.description: LLM-driven pipeline that emits large-scale interactive 3D environments with dynamic agents and physics via an industry-grade rendering engine.

entries.name: UrbanWorld2.0
entries.fullTitle: UrbanWorld2.0: A Multimodal Agentic Framework for Reality-Aligned 3D World Generation at City-Scale
entries.description: Agentic multimodal engine for generating reality-aligned, city-scale 3D urban worlds.

entries.name: WonderZoom
entries.fullTitle: WonderZoom: Multi-Scale 3D World Generation
entries.description: From the WonderWorld/WonderJourney line: scale-aware 3D representation that generates coherent scene content across multiple spatial scales from one image.

entries.name: WorldFlow3D
entries.fullTitle: WorldFlow3D: Flowing Through 3D Distributions for Unbounded World Generation
entries.description: Models unbounded 3D world generation as flow-matching transport between 3D distributions.

entries.name: GTA
entries.fullTitle: GTA: Advancing Image-to-3D World Generation via Geometry Then Appearance Video Diffusion
entries.description: Two-stage geometry-then-appearance video diffusion for image-to-3D world generation, prioritizing underlying geometry over appearance-first pipelines.

entries.name: Walking in the Implicit
entries.fullTitle: Walking in the Implicit: Interactive World Exploration via Neural Scene Representation
entries.description: Interactive free exploration of generated worlds through an implicit neural scene representation rather than replayed video rollouts.

entries.name: Genie Sim PanoWorld
entries.fullTitle: Genie Sim PanoWorld: An Infinite Indoor 3D World Generation Pipeline via Panoramic Scene Modeling and Simulation
entries.description: Two-stage feed-forward pipeline turning a single 360° panorama into a freely navigable indoor 3D scene with metric trajectory control, without per-scene optimization.

entries.name: Sekai2
entries.fullTitle: Sekai2: From World Exploration to Interactive World Modeling
entries.description: Multi-source real-world video dataset with camera trajectories and temporally grounded semantics for training long-horizon, camera-controllable world exploration models (dataset resource).

entries.name: WorldRover
entries.fullTitle: WorldRover: A Scalable Synthetic Video Data Engine for World Exploration with Rich Annotations
entries.description: Rendering-based data engine supplying video with exact camera motion, dense geometry, correspondence, and control signals for explorable world model training (dataset resource).

entries.name: VideoTok4D / Co4DGen
entries.fullTitle: VideoTok4D: A 4D-Aware Video Tokenizer for Compact World Representation
entries.description: Factorizes video into static and dynamic tokens, aligns dynamic attention along tracks, and learns a compact diffusion prior for 4D scene generation.

entries.name: Streaming4D
entries.fullTitle: Streaming4D: Accelerate 4D World Models via Block-wise Video Generation and Incremental Reconstruction
entries.description: Overlaps block-wise autoregressive video generation with incremental 3D reconstruction so the explicit 4D scene updates online as each generated video block becomes available.

entries.name: 4DGS-WAM
entries.fullTitle: 4DGS-WAM: Bridging Past and Future with an Object-Centric World Action Model based on 4D Gaussian Splatting
entries.description: Separates static Gaussian scene content from predicted transformations of dynamic objects, combining future action prediction with persistent 4D representations for KITTI-MOT sequence modeling.

entries.name: 4DStreamCtrl
entries.fullTitle: 4DStreamCtrl: Interactive Video Generation with Online 4D Control
entries.description: Unifies camera motion, object trajectories, and depth as 3D point tracks, using a geometric motion head and causal distillation for streaming video with online 4D control.

entries.name: SpaceTimePilot
entries.fullTitle: SpaceTimePilot: Generative Rendering of Dynamic Scenes Across Space and Time
entries.description: Disentangles camera and motion-time control to rerender dynamic video scenes along arbitrary space-time trajectories.

entries.name: MorphoSim
entries.fullTitle: MorphoSim: An Interactive, Controllable, and Editable Language-guided 4D World Simulator
entries.description: Generates editable 4D environments with language-guided object trajectories and consistent views from arbitrary cameras.

entries.name: ReCamMaster
entries.fullTitle: ReCamMaster: Camera-Controlled Generative Rendering from A Single Video
entries.description: Rerenders dynamic scenes from a single video under novel camera trajectories while preserving motion and appearance consistency.

entries.name: OVOW
entries.fullTitle: One Video, One World: Turning Monocular Video into Physical 4D Scenes
entries.description: Reconstructs instance-level, simulation-ready 4D mesh scenes from a single monocular video, including watertight geometry, metric object trajectories, physical scene assembly, and standardized interfaces for downstream simulation.

entries.name: Light-X
entries.fullTitle: Light-X: Generative 4D Video Rendering with Camera and Illumination Control
entries.description: Uses dynamic point-cloud geometry to jointly control camera trajectories and illumination when rendering new 4D video views from monocular input, separating geometric motion from lighting variation.

entries.name: VerseCrafter
entries.fullTitle: VerseCrafter: Dynamic Realistic Video World Model with 4D Geometric Control
entries.description: Adds explicit 4D geometric control to realistic video world modeling.

entries.name: Kinema4D
entries.fullTitle: Kinema4D: Kinematic 4D World Modeling for Spatiotemporal Embodied Simulation
entries.description: Couples 4D scene generation with kinematic constraints for embodied simulation rather than static 3D reconstruction alone.

entries.name: Beyond Pixel Histories
entries.fullTitle: Beyond Pixel Histories: World Models with Persistent 3D State
entries.description: Introduces persistent 3D state into interactive world modeling, addressing the weak spatial memory of pure video-history approaches.

entries.name: DGGT
entries.fullTitle: DGGT: Feedforward 4D Reconstruction of Dynamic Driving Scenes using Unposed Images
entries.description: Performs feedforward, pose-free 4D reconstruction of dynamic driving scenes by jointly predicting per-frame 3D Gaussian maps, camera parameters, dynamic trajectories, and temporally varying visibility.

entries.name: FR3D
entries.fullTitle: Future Dynamic 3D Reconstruction: Toward 3D World Modeling with Disentangled Ego-Motion
entries.description: Predicts persistent 3D latent scene evolution while disentangling ego-motion from dynamic world motion for longer-horizon consistency.

entries.name: MoVerse
entries.fullTitle: MoVerse: Real-Time Video World Modeling with Panoramic Gaussian Scaffold
entries.description: Builds a navigable 3D world from one narrow-FOV image via panoramic Gaussian scaffolding and real-time video rendering.

entries.name: Olaf-World
entries.fullTitle: Olaf-World: Orienting Latent Actions for Video World Modeling
entries.description: A useful step toward controllable latent-action video world models.

entries.name: DeepVerse
entries.fullTitle: DeepVerse: 4D Autoregressive Video Generation as a World Model
entries.description: View-conditioned 4D interactive world modeling with explicit geometry-aware dynamics.

entries.name: TeleWorld
entries.fullTitle: TeleWorld: Towards Dynamic Multimodal Synthesis with a 4D World Model
entries.description: Unifies video generation, dynamic scene reconstruction, and long-term world memory for real-time 4D multimodal synthesis.

entries.name: AnchorWorld
entries.fullTitle: AnchorWorld: Embodied Egocentric World Simulation with View-based Evolution Customization
entries.description: Uses 3D human motion and anchor-view customization to keep egocentric interactive world simulation spatially grounded and controllable over evolving scenes.

entries.name: HoloTime
entries.fullTitle: HoloTime: Taming Video Diffusion Models for Panoramic 4D Scene Generation
entries.description: Maintains a persistent 4D Gaussian scene state distilled from panorama-conditioned panoramic video, so a dynamic scene can be re-rendered from user-chosen novel viewpoints over time instead of replayed as a fixed clip.

entries.name: 4Real
entries.fullTitle: 4Real: Towards Photorealistic 4D Scene Generation via Video Diffusion Models
entries.description: Text-to-4D photorealistic dynamic scene generation by distilling video diffusion priors into deformable 3D Gaussians.

entries.name: DreamScene4D
entries.fullTitle: DreamScene4D: Dynamic Multi-Object Scene Generation from Monocular Videos
entries.description: Lifts in-the-wild monocular videos with multiple interacting objects and occlusions into dynamic 4D Gaussian scenes with recovered object motion.

entries.name: DimensionX
entries.fullTitle: DimensionX: Create Any 3D and 4D Scenes from a Single Image with Controllable Video Diffusion
entries.description: Decouples spatial (camera) and temporal (dynamics) factors in controllable video diffusion to build 3D and 4D scenes from a single image.

entries.name: CAT4D
entries.fullTitle: CAT4D: Create Anything in 4D with Multi-View Video Diffusion Models
entries.description: Multi-view video diffusion that converts monocular video into dynamic 4D scenes with disentangled camera and time control.

entries.name: Free4D
entries.fullTitle: Free4D: Tuning-free 4D Scene Generation with Spatial-Temporal Consistency
entries.description: Tuning-free lifting of a single image or video into a spatio-temporally consistent 4D scene representation using pretrained foundation models.

entries.name: WonderPlay
entries.fullTitle: WonderPlay: Dynamic 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image and Actions
entries.description: Action-conditioned dynamic 3D scenes from one image: a physics simulator drives coarse dynamics and a video generator refines them, closing the loop between simulation and generation.

entries.name: DSG-World
entries.fullTitle: DSG-World: Learning a 3D Gaussian World Model from Dual State Videos
entries.description: Builds an explicit, physically consistent 3D Gaussian world model from two-state video observations in a single pass, supporting simulation-ready scene manipulation.

entries.name: 4DGT
entries.fullTitle: 4DGT: Learning a 4D Gaussian Transformer Using Real-World Monocular Videos
entries.description: Feed-forward 4D Gaussian transformer trained purely on real-world monocular videos, unifying static and dynamic scene components with varying object lifespans.

entries.name: 4Real-Video-V2
entries.fullTitle: 4Real-Video-V2: Fused View-Time Attention and Feedforward Reconstruction for 4D Scene Generation
entries.description: Fused view-time attention plus feedforward reconstruction for joint multi-view video synthesis and 4D scene recovery.

entries.name: 4DNeX
entries.fullTitle: 4DNeX: Feed-Forward 4D Generative Modeling Made Easy
entries.description: First feed-forward single-image-to-4D framework, fine-tuning a video diffusion model to output dynamic 3D scene representations without per-scene optimization.

entries.name: TiP4GEN
entries.fullTitle: TiP4GEN: Text to Immersive Panorama 4D Scene Generation
entries.description: Text-driven 360° panoramic 4D scene generation, extending panoramic world generation from static scenes to dynamics.

entries.name: See4D
entries.fullTitle: See4D: Pose-Free 4D Generation via Auto-Regressive Video Inpainting
entries.description: Pose-free video-to-4D generation via warp-then-inpaint autoregression, removing the camera-annotation requirement for in-the-wild footage.

entries.name: Diff4Splat
entries.fullTitle: Diff4Splat: Controllable 4D Scene Generation with Latent Dynamic Reconstruction Models
entries.description: Combines video diffusion with latent dynamic reconstruction to produce controllable 4D Gaussian scenes.

entries.name: One4D
entries.fullTitle: One4D: Unified 4D Generation and Reconstruction via Decoupled LoRA Control
entries.description: One framework spanning 4D generation from a single image, 4D reconstruction from full video, and mixed regimes, emitting synchronized RGB frames and pointmaps.

entries.name: DynamicVerse
entries.fullTitle: DynamicVerse: A Physically-Aware Multimodal Framework for 4D World Modeling
entries.description: Physically-aware 4D modeling framework that converts internet video into metric-scale 4D data with geometry, motion, and captions for world-model training.

entries.name: NeoVerse
entries.fullTitle: NeoVerse: Enhancing 4D World Model with in-the-wild Monocular Videos
entries.description: 4D world model trained scalably from in-the-wild monocular videos, supporting 4D reconstruction and novel-trajectory video generation without specialized multi-view data.

entries.name: Mirage2Matter
entries.fullTitle: Mirage2Matter: A Physically Grounded Gaussian World Model from Video
entries.description: Builds physically grounded Gaussian world models from ordinary video without depth sensors or calibration, narrowing the visual and physical sim-to-real gap.

entries.name: PerpetualWonder
entries.fullTitle: PerpetualWonder: Long-Horizon Action-Conditioned 4D Scene Generation
entries.description: Long-horizon action-conditioned 4D scene rollout, extending single-shot 4D generation toward persistent interactive dynamics.

entries.name: Genie 4D
entries.fullTitle: Genie 4D: Semantic-Prior-Guided 4D Dynamic Scene Reconstruction
entries.description: Turns hand-held phone capture into a semantically grounded, action-controllable 4D world model via a real-time visual-inertial Gaussian splatting front end.

entries.name: Full-4D
entries.fullTitle: Full-4D: Generating Full-Scope 4D Scenes from a Single-View Video
entries.description: Generates fully explorable dynamic 4D scenes (not just small viewpoint perturbations) from a single-view video.

entries.name: CP4D
entries.fullTitle: CP4D: Compositional Physics-aware 4D Scene Generation
entries.description: Compositional 4D scene generation with per-object physical plausibility constraints.

entries.name: PhysReal
entries.fullTitle: PhysReal: Learning Real-World Deformable Object Physics via Hybrid Constitutive Modeling
entries.description: Identifies spatially varying deformable-material dynamics from video using hybrid analytical and neural constitutive models, differentiable MPM simulation, and Gaussian rendering for future-state prediction.

entries.name: Out-of-this-World-Model
entries.fullTitle: GPU-Accelerated Astrodynamics World Models for Spacecraft Rendezvous and Proximity Operations
entries.description: Predicts spacecraft kinematic and camera-observation dynamics under commanded thrust and torque using transformer latent states and one-step flow matching; includes a GPU-parallel ISS docking environment.

entries.name: Rollout-Decoded Reconstruction
entries.fullTitle: Rollout-Decoded Reconstruction for Long-Horizon Prediction in Latent World Models
entries.description: Trains decoders on free-running latent rollouts with an additional reconstruction loss, extending prediction horizons on chaotic Kuramoto-Sivashinsky dynamics without adding parameters.

entries.name: MOSH-WM
entries.fullTitle: MOSH-WM: Mask-Grounded Soft-Hamiltonian Dynamics for Object-Centric World Models
entries.description: Grounds object-slot dynamics in mask-derived positions and soft Hamiltonian structure while preserving appearance separately, reducing error accumulation in object-centric video rollouts.

entries.name: ADAPT
entries.fullTitle: ADAPT: Physics-Aware Diffusion-based World Models for Adaptive Predictive Transferable HVAC Control
entries.description: Predicts action-conditioned indoor thermal trajectories with conditional diffusion and a learned multi-zone heat-balance regularizer, supplying predictive state information for HVAC reinforcement learning across climates.

entries.name: ChronoEdit
entries.fullTitle: ChronoEdit: Towards Temporal Reasoning for Image Editing and World Simulation
entries.description: Uses temporally reasoned video trajectories to constrain physically consistent image edits and introduces PBench-Edit.

entries.name: Force Prompting
entries.fullTitle: Force Prompting: Video Generation Models Can Learn and Generalize Physics-based Control Signals
entries.description: Conditions video generation on point forces and wind fields to simulate controllable physical interactions.

entries.name: WISA
entries.fullTitle: WISA: World Simulator Assistant for Physics-Aware Text-to-Video Generation
entries.description: Adds explicit physical descriptions, categories, and properties to video generation and introduces the WISA-32K physical-video dataset.

entries.name: LLMPhy
entries.fullTitle: LLMPhy: Parameter-Identifiable Physical Reasoning Combining Large Language Models and Physics Engines
entries.description: Uses language-generated simulation programs and iterative feedback to identify scene parameters and construct physical digital twins.

entries.name: Transformers and Slot Encoding for Sample Efficient Physical World Modelling
entries.fullTitle: Transformers and Slot Encoding for Sample Efficient Physical World Modelling
entries.description: Combines slot-attention object representations with transformer dynamics for sample-efficient physical prediction.

entries.name: A Compositional Object-Based Approach to Learning Physical Dynamics
entries.fullTitle: A Compositional Object-Based Approach to Learning Physical Dynamics
entries.description: Learns object-based physical simulators by composing pairwise interactions, supporting motion prediction and transfer across object counts.

entries.name: DPI-Net
entries.fullTitle: Learning Particle Dynamics for Manipulating Rigid Bodies, Deformable Objects, and Fluids
entries.description: Graph neural network world model for particle-based physics simulation.

entries.name: FIGNet
entries.fullTitle: Learning rigid dynamics with face interaction graph networks
entries.description: Models rigid-body collisions through interactions between mesh faces and learns frictional dynamics for physical simulation and planning.

entries.name: Physics Cognition in Video Generation
entries.fullTitle: Exploring the Evolution of Physics Cognition in Video Generation: A Survey

entries.name: PhyWorld
entries.fullTitle: How Far is Video Generation from World Model: A Physical Law Perspective
entries.description: A physically grounded diagnostic that asks whether video generators obey the laws needed for usable world simulation.

entries.name: Physically Native World Models
entries.fullTitle: Physically Native World Models: A Hamiltonian Perspective on Generative World Modeling
entries.description: Frames physically grounded world modeling through Hamiltonian-inspired latent dynamics, control, and dissipation.

entries.name: LaWM
entries.fullTitle: LaWM: Least Action World Models for Long-Horizon Physical Consistency from Visual Observations
entries.description: Uses a latent variational integrator so long-horizon rollouts are induced by a learned least-action principle.

entries.name: ACWM-Phys
entries.fullTitle: ACWM-Phys: Investigating Generalized Physical Interaction in Action-Conditioned Video World Models
entries.description: Probes whether action-conditioned video world models capture generalized physical interactions beyond visual interpolation.

entries.name: Physically Viable World Models
entries.fullTitle: Physically Viable World Models: A Case for Query-Conditioned Embodied AI
entries.description: Argues for query-conditioned physical abstractions that preserve intervention-relevant structure for planning, control, and verification.

entries.name: OptiWorld
entries.fullTitle: OptiWorld: Optimal Control for Video World Generation under Physical Constraints
entries.description: Introduces optimal-control guidance for video world generation so generated dynamics satisfy smoother, safer, and more physically plausible constraints.

entries.name: Physical Object Understanding
entries.fullTitle: Physical Object Understanding with a Physically Controllable World Model
entries.description: Learns object-level physical structure from video and exposes controllable interactions, a useful bridge between visual prediction and physical reasoning.

entries.name: MeGAS
entries.fullTitle: MeGAS: Thermomechanical Dynamic Gaussian Splatting for Thermophysical Scene Editing
entries.description: Adds temperature-aware MPM dynamics and thermomechanical phase changes to dynamic Gaussian splatting, strengthening the physics side of editable visual world models.

entries.name: PhysiFormer
entries.fullTitle: PhysiFormer: Learning to Simulate Mechanics in World Space
entries.description: Diffusion-transformer mechanics simulator that predicts probabilistic future 3D mesh trajectories directly in world coordinates for rigid and elastic objects.

entries.name: LithoDreamer
entries.fullTitle: LithoDreamer: A Physics-Informed World Model for Multi-Stage Computational Lithography
entries.description: Models lithography as a multi-stage physical state-evolution process, pairing forward prediction with intervention optimization for inverse planning.

entries.name: Interaction Networks
entries.fullTitle: Interaction Networks for Learning about Objects, Relations and Physics
entries.description: Foundational learned physics simulator: object- and relation-centric dynamics model that rolls out n-body, rigid-collision, and non-rigid systems.

entries.name: IntPhys
entries.fullTitle: IntPhys: A Framework and Benchmark for Visual Intuitive Physics Reasoning
entries.description: Violation-of-expectation benchmark (object permanence, shape constancy, spatio-temporal continuity) for evaluating intuitive physics in predictive models.

entries.name: PHYRE
entries.fullTitle: PHYRE: A New Benchmark for Physical Reasoning
entries.description: 2D physics-puzzle benchmark where agents act by intervention (placing objects) and must predict resulting dynamics; a standard testbed for physical world models.

entries.name: CoPhy
entries.fullTitle: CoPhy: Counterfactual Learning of Physical Dynamics
entries.description: Counterfactual physical dynamics benchmark and model: predict outcomes after a do-intervention modifies the initial scene.

entries.name: CLEVRER
entries.fullTitle: CLEVRER: Collision Events for Video Representation and Reasoning
entries.description: Diagnostic video benchmark for descriptive, explanatory, predictive, and counterfactual reasoning about collision dynamics.

entries.name: GNS
entries.fullTitle: Learning to Simulate Complex Physics with Graph Networks
entries.description: Graph network simulator for fluids, rigid solids, and deformables; the standard particle-based learned physics simulator that FIGNet (already listed) builds on.

entries.name: Physion
entries.fullTitle: Physion: Evaluating Physical Prediction from Vision in Humans and Machines
entries.description: Human-calibrated benchmark of visual physical prediction across eight scenario types (support, collide, contain, drape, etc.).

entries.name: PhysGaussian
entries.fullTitle: PhysGaussian: Physics-Integrated 3D Gaussians for Generative Dynamics
entries.description: Embeds continuum-mechanics (MPM) dynamics directly into 3D Gaussian scene representations, unifying simulation and rendering ("what you see is what you simulate").

entries.name: PhysDreamer
entries.fullTitle: PhysDreamer: Physics-Based Interaction with 3D Objects via Video Generation
entries.description: Distills material properties from video-generation priors into 3D objects so static assets respond realistically to novel interaction forces.

entries.name: PhysGen (ECCV 2024)
entries.fullTitle: PhysGen: Rigid-Body Physics-Grounded Image-to-Video Generation
entries.description: Simulation-in-the-loop image-to-video: rigid-body simulation of inferred scene physics drives generative rendering under user-specified forces. Distinct from the 2026 PhysGen (2603.00110) already listed.

entries.name: Physics-IQ
entries.fullTitle: Do generative video models understand physical principles?
entries.description: Original Physics-IQ benchmark (real-video physical understanding across solids, fluids, optics, thermodynamics, magnetism); shows visual realism does not imply physics understanding. The already-listed "Physics-IQ Verified" (2606.18943) is its audited follow-up.

entries.name: ThermoForce
entries.fullTitle: ThermoForce: A Physics-Structured Interventional World Model for Building HVAC Control
entries.description: Separates passive forecasting from causal response to control interventions with a physics-structured thermal world model; a clean case study in intervention-valid world modeling.

entries.name: Mechanistic World Models
entries.fullTitle: From Observation to Insight: Mechanistic World Models and the Quest for Autonomous Discovery
entries.description: Position paper arguing that scientific discovery requires world models that expose reusable explanatory mechanisms rather than pure predictive accuracy.

entries.name: POKEWORLD
entries.fullTitle: What Can Latent World Models Know? Physical Parameter Identifiability in Multimodal Predictive Representations
entries.description: Certificate-gated protocol testing which hidden physical parameters (mass, drag, stiffness) actually enter a latent world model's representation.

entries.name: ODEWorld
entries.fullTitle: ODEWorld: A Continuous Predictive Architecture via Physical-Time Flow
entries.description: Learns a continuous latent velocity field in physical time (ODE-parameterized) instead of discrete-step prediction for world modeling of continuous dynamics.

entries.name: PhiZero
entries.fullTitle: PhiZero: A World Model Built Around Physical Language
entries.description: Learns a compact discrete "physical language" of world-state transitions from in-the-wild video and predicts in that space rather than in pixels.

entries.name: ClosurePairs
entries.fullTitle: Why Does the Future Branch? Identifiable Closure Tests for Stochastic Physical World Models
entries.description: Proves ordinary transitions cannot distinguish state-aliasing from intrinsic stochasticity in physical world models, and gives an identifiable test that can.

entries.name: HERA
entries.fullTitle: HERA: Historical Evidence Routing Adapter for Physical Prediction in Latent World Models
entries.description: Routes preserved historical evidence back into latent predictions so physical events under occlusion remain predictable when the evidence leaves the current view.

entries.name: PhyS
entries.fullTitle: Distilling Physical Priors into Streaming World Models
entries.description: Injects physics priors into few-step causal streaming world models, addressing prior loss during bidirectional-to-causal distillation.

entries.name: Learned Physical Invariants
entries.fullTitle: Correcting a learned physical invariant improves world-model rollouts
entries.description: Recovers an energy-like conserved quantity inside a frozen DreamerV3 latent and projects rollouts back onto its level set, reducing long-horizon rollout error.

entries.name: Earth System World Model
entries.fullTitle: Earth System World Model for What-If Simulations: A Case Study for Terrestrial Ecosystems
entries.description: Learns intervention-conditioned ecosystem transitions through transition-action pretraining and masked response learning, supporting partial state edits and coupled long-horizon ecosystem responses.

entries.name: Pangu-Weather

entries.name: Cycle-World
entries.fullTitle: Cycle-World: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Long-term Video World Models via Reverse-Prediction Cycle Consistency
entries.description: Proves forward generative drift is bounded by a cycle-consistency objective; a reverse-prediction model embeds the constraint at training and doubles as a runtime gradient corrector that suppresses errors before they enter the rollout history.

entries.name: Self Gradient Forcing
entries.fullTitle: Self Gradient Forcing: Native Long Video Extrapolation
entries.description: Closes the historical context-gradient gap in self-forcing: a two-pass scheme lets future losses supervise how earlier latents are written into the KV memory, extrapolating minutes-long rollouts from 5-second training windows.

entries.fullTitle: Visko Orbis 1.0: A Live Model for Real-Time Interactive Long Video Generation
entries.description: "Live model" whose prompt can be changed at any moment with the update visible in real time; bounded multi-scale memory preserves subjects and scenes across chunks over hour-scale 4K/24 FPS rollouts.
