entries.fullTitle: FreqForcing: Autoregressive Long Video Generation via Spectral Self-Anchoring
entries.description: Characterizes rollout error accumulation as low-frequency spectral energy drift and counters it training-free with spectral self-anchoring, extending 5-second self-forcing models to two-minute (24×) streaming rollouts.

entries.fullTitle: MiniWorld: Democratizing the Training of Video World Models from Scratch
entries.description: Lightweight, fully reproducible from-scratch recipe for streaming block-causal video world models (diffusion-forcing noise schedule, rolling KV cache, pipelined asynchronous denoising) trainable in days on one 8-GPU server, with released code and checkpoints.

entries.fullTitle: Overcoming Statistical Bias in Action-Controllable World Models
entries.description: Enforces counterfactual consistency (inverse-action, zero-action, and mirrored-scene rollouts) so predicted dynamics genuinely depend on actions rather than visual inertia, with new controllability metrics and top average success on VP2 visual planning.

entries.name: LDR
entries.fullTitle: Learning How the World Evolves: Extrapolative Video World Models via Latent Dynamics Reasoning
entries.description: Casts latent transitions as explicit kinematic integration over structured latents (the model regresses only higher-order residuals), achieving out-of-distribution dynamics extrapolation with a 20× smaller ID–OOD gap at a fraction of the compute.

entries.name: Stream Forcing
entries.fullTitle: Stream Forcing: Constructing Unified Training Trajectory for Robust Streaming Video Generation
entries.description: Reformulates video diffusion sampling as a frame-indexed stochastic noise process and builds a continuous training trajectory toward inference-consistent sampling, closing the streaming train–inference mismatch that world-model rollouts inherit.

entries.name: ForgeWM
entries.fullTitle: ForgeWM: Progressive Causal Training for Few-Step Action-Conditioned Video World Models
entries.description: Four-stage progressive causal distillation turns bidirectional action-conditioned generators into 1/2/4-step world models that keep keyboard/mouse actions aligned with compressed latent chunks (Minecraft and gamepad FPS), plus a latency/replay-refinement dual-path deployment protocol.

entries.name: EchoWM
entries.fullTitle: EchoWM: Open and Enterable Omnimodal World Models
entries.description: Open "enterable" world model responding to continuous navigation via a shared metric-scale 6-DoF trajectory interface while jointly generating 720p video with synchronized environmental sound, music, and speech over long-horizon autoregressive rollouts.
entries.section: 1.6 🎞️ General Video World Models & Rollout Backbones

entries.name: ShotStream
entries.fullTitle: ShotStream: Streaming Multi-Shot Video Generation for Interactive Storytelling
entries.description: Carries a global cache of sparsely selected conditional frames from earlier shots into causal streaming generation of each next shot, accepting newly injected story prompts after prior shots are already generated, so the narrative can be steered mid-rollout rather than fixed in an offline script.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: CausalCine
entries.fullTitle: CausalCine: Real-Time Autoregressive Generation for Multi-Shot Video Narratives
entries.description: Turns multi-shot generation into an online directing process: a causal model trained on native multi-shot sequences accepts dynamic prompts on the fly, generates across shot boundaries, and routes cross-shot memory by attention relevance (CAMR) under a bounded active cache.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: ContextMaster
entries.fullTitle: ContextMaster: Interactive Multi-Shot Video Creation via Fixed-Budget Sparse Context Routing
entries.description: Formalizes interactive multi-shot video creation: one model generates, follows references, or edits footage while maintaining a shared expanding history accessed through fixed-budget sparse context routing, running at 16 FPS after privileged context distillation.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: Vorch-Director
entries.fullTitle: Vorch-Director: Interactive World Story Model via Noise-Aware Error Rectification
entries.description: Continues a world story by conditioning each extension on its own previously generated audio-visual history, with noise-level-aware residual correction to keep multi-shot, multi-subject, reference-guided rollouts stable at minute scale.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: StoryMem
entries.fullTitle: StoryMem: Multi-shot Long Video Storytelling with Memory
entries.description: Keeps a dynamically updated memory of keyframes selected from previously generated shots and conditions a memory-to-video model on it when producing each subsequent shot under its own prompt, so later shots inherit scene and character appearance from earlier ones.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: OneStory
entries.fullTitle: OneStory: Coherent Multi-Shot Video Generation with Adaptive Memory
entries.description: Selects caption-relevant latent frames from prior shots as an adaptive memory and conditions each new shot on them under its per-shot prompt, propagating visual context across shot boundaries inside the model rather than generating independent clips.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: FilmWeaver
entries.fullTitle: FilmWeaver: Weaving Consistent Multi-Shot Videos with Cache-Guided Autoregressive Diffusion
entries.description: Feeds a dual-level cache into each autoregressively generated next shot — prior-shot keyframes for cross-shot identity and scene context, plus recent within-shot frame history for motion continuity — enabling arbitrary-length multi-shot rollouts whose later shots consume context from earlier ones.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: STAGE (narrative)
entries.fullTitle: STAGE: Storyboard-Anchored Generation for Cinematic Multi-shot Narrative
entries.description: Conditions each subsequent shot on an entity-consistency memory pack gathered from earlier shots together with predicted start/end storyboard anchors, rendering the narrative script as anchored multi-shot rollouts rather than independently prompted clips. (Distinct from the driving world model STAGE in §1.2.1.)
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: Make-A-Story
entries.fullTitle: Make-A-Story: Visual Memory Conditioned Consistent Story Generation
entries.description: Story-visualization precursor (still images, not video): an autoregressive visual memory over previously generated frames and sentences resolves co-references and keeps actor and background appearance consistent across the frame sequence.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: EM-Vid
entries.fullTitle: EM-Vid: Training-Free Entity-Centric Memory for Efficient and Consistent Multi-Shot Video Generation
entries.description: Replaces full-frame history with an entity-indexed bank of latent patches under a budgeted update strategy; each new shot attends sparsely only to entity-relevant memory tokens, disentangling persistent entity state from transient scene context.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: GroundShot
entries.fullTitle: GroundShot: Visually Consistent Multi-Shot Long Video Generation via Entity-Grounded Shot Scheduling
entries.description: Builds an entity-level visual memory online from accepted generated shots — grounding, verifying, and retrieving entity references — and schedules shot generation order by expected reference usefulness, with the GroundBench entity-consistency diagnostic.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: UnityShots
entries.fullTitle: UnityShots: Memory-Driven Multi-Shot Audio-Video Generation with Boundary-Aware Gating
entries.description: Maintains fixed-size long-term (opening-shot anchor) and short-term (previous tail) memory slots updated at every cut by a boundary-conditioned gate fusing cut probability and beat signals, with a speaker token persisting voice identity across shots.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: SlotMem
entries.fullTitle: SlotMem: Character-Addressable Internal Memory for Narrative Long Video Generation
entries.description: Character-addressable slot memory: a semantic probe localizes character tokens, a memory writer conservatively updates each character's compact slot as generation proceeds, and character-wise cross-attention re-injects the right memory across scene transitions and long temporal gaps.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: JoyAI-Echo-1.5
entries.fullTitle: Long-Horizon Audio-Visual Generation for Persistent Stories and Interactive Worlds
entries.description: Unified system whose long-video variant aggregates composable cross-shot memory (multi-shot visual evidence plus speech-filtered speaker cues) for persistent character appearance and voice, while a world-model variant adds calibrated metric 6-DoF navigation control (ranked first on WBench).
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: FilmWorld
entries.fullTitle: FilmWorld: Agentic Novel-to-Film Generation through Dynamic Cinematic World Modeling
entries.description: Formalizes novel-to-film generation as dynamic cinematic world modeling. Specialized agents construct persistent world entities, propagate their states across scenes, plan shots from those states, and verify cross-shot causal and visual consistency in a closed loop.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: MovieDreamer
entries.fullTitle: MovieDreamer: Hierarchical Generation for Coherent Long Visual Sequence
entries.description: Builds a multimodal script — character descriptions with face embeddings, scene elements, and plot — and autoregressively predicts later keyframes conditioned on it before diffusion renders each clip, planning long multi-scene narratives instead of prompting shots independently.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: VideoDirectorGPT
entries.fullTitle: VideoDirectorGPT: Consistent Multi-scene Video Generation via LLM-Guided Planning
entries.description: Generates an upfront LLM video plan — scene descriptions, entity lists, per-scene layouts, and consistency groupings marking which entities recur — and feeds it to a layout-guided renderer for each scene, coordinating multi-scene generation through the shared plan rather than a list of independent shot prompts.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: ReCA
entries.fullTitle: ReCA: Multi-Shot Long Video Extrapolation via Recursive Context Allocation
entries.description: Defines multi-shot video extrapolation — continuing an observed anchor state through cinematically structured shots — and solves it with recursive context allocation that decomposes planning/generation into context-bounded subproblems and propagates structured state updates across frozen-generator calls.
categoryPath: 1.7 🎬 Persistent Narrative & Multi-Shot Video World Models

entries.name: Asynchronous Sensor World Models
entries.fullTitle: World Models Under Asynchronous Sensor Observations
entries.description: Studies staleness and sensor-refresh conditioning in learned dynamics and MPC, identifying when asynchronous sampling schedules supply causally useful predictive information.

entries.name: Counterfactual Latent World Models
entries.fullTitle: Learning Counterfactual World Models for Embodied Reasoning under Partial Observability
entries.description: Combines recurrent belief states with contrastive intervention-conditioned futures to distinguish perceptually similar states that require different actions under partial observability.

entries.name: Reading the Room
entries.fullTitle: Reading the Room: Implicit Confusion Encoding in Recurrent World Model States
entries.description: Probes and intervenes on RSSM states to study an implicit history-dependent confusion signal and its limited usefulness for deciding when to verify imagined predictions.

entries.name: Next Embedding Prediction Makes World Models Stronger
entries.fullTitle: Next Embedding Prediction Makes World Models Stronger
entries.description: Trains decoder-free recurrent dynamics through temporal-transformer next-embedding prediction for partially observable control.

entries.name: DyMoDreamer
entries.fullTitle: DyMoDreamer: World Modeling with Dynamic Modulation
entries.description: Adds motion-focused stochastic modulation to recurrent state-space dynamics for more effective visual reinforcement learning.

entries.name: Dynamics-Aligned Latent Imagination in Contextual World Models for Zero-Shot Generalization
entries.fullTitle: Dynamics-Aligned Latent Imagination in Contextual World Models for Zero-Shot Generalization
entries.description: Infers latent environmental context from interaction dynamics to support counterfactual imagination and zero-shot policy transfer.

entries.name: Dyn-O
entries.fullTitle: Dyn-O: Building Structured World Models with Object-Centric Representations
entries.description: Learns object-centric dynamics from complex visual scenes and separates static and dynamic factors for controllable imagined trajectories.

entries.name: Time-Aware World Model for Adaptive Prediction and Control
entries.fullTitle: Time-Aware World Model for Adaptive Prediction and Control
entries.description: Conditions learned dynamics on variable time-step sizes for prediction and control across changing observation rates.

entries.name: Learning Abstract World Models with a Group-Structured Latent Space
entries.fullTitle: Learning Abstract World Models with a Group-Structured Latent Space
entries.description: Imposes group symmetries on latent transition models to improve dynamics prediction and downstream reinforcement learning.

entries.name: Adapting World Models with Latent-State Dynamics Residuals
entries.fullTitle: Adapting World Models with Latent-State Dynamics Residuals
entries.description: Calibrates simulation-pretrained latent dynamics with residual corrections and trains policies in the adapted imagined environment.

entries.name: TWISTER
entries.fullTitle: Learning Transformer-based World Models with Contrastive Predictive Coding
entries.description: Uses action-conditioned contrastive prediction over longer horizons to improve transformer-world-model representations and reinforcement learning.

entries.name: Spiking World Model with Multi-Compartment Neurons for Model-based Reinforcement Learning
entries.fullTitle: Spiking World Model with Multi-Compartment Neurons for Model-based Reinforcement Learning
entries.description: Builds a spiking-neural world model with multi-compartment temporal memory for model-based reinforcement learning.

entries.name: Discrete Codebook World Models for Continuous Control
entries.fullTitle: Discrete Codebook World Models for Continuous Control
entries.description: Learns stochastic discrete-codebook latent dynamics and combines them with model-predictive control for continuous-action tasks.

entries.name: DMWM
entries.fullTitle: DMWM: Dual-Mind World Model with Long-Term Imagination
entries.description: Couples recurrent latent dynamics with a logic-guided reasoning component to improve consistency of long-horizon imagination.

entries.name: Trajectory World Models for Heterogeneous Environments
entries.fullTitle: Trajectory World Models for Heterogeneous Environments
entries.description: Pretrains transferable dynamics across heterogeneous sensor and actuator spaces for off-policy evaluation and model-predictive control.

entries.name: Object-Centric World Models from Few-Shot Annotations for Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
entries.fullTitle: Object-Centric World Models from Few-Shot Annotations for Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
entries.description: Uses sparsely annotated object-centric representations to focus a world model on task-critical dynamics in visually complex reinforcement learning.

entries.name: SPARTAN
entries.fullTitle: SPARTAN: A Sparse Transformer World Model Attending to What Matters
entries.description: Learns sparse object-interaction graphs with transformer attention to predict dynamics and adapt to targeted environment changes.

entries.name: Efficient World Models with Context-Aware Tokenization
entries.fullTitle: Efficient World Models with Context-Aware Tokenization
entries.description: Introduces delta-IRIS, which models stochastic observation changes with context-aware tokenization to shorten world-model sequences.

entries.name: Learning Latent Dynamic Robust Representations for World Models
entries.fullTitle: Learning Latent Dynamic Robust Representations for World Models
entries.description: Combines temporal masking, bisimulation, and a hybrid recurrent state-space model to learn dynamics robust to visual distractors.

entries.name: Compete and Compose
entries.fullTitle: Compete and Compose: Learning Independent Mechanisms for Modular World Models
entries.description: Learns independent dynamics mechanisms through competition and recomposes them to adapt to interventions and new environments.

entries.name: AD3
entries.fullTitle: AD3: Implicit Action is the Key for World Models to Distinguish the Diverse Visual Distractors
entries.description: Infers implicit distractor actions and trains separate dynamics to isolate task-relevant state for visual control.

entries.name: Mastering Memory Tasks with World Models
entries.fullTitle: Mastering Memory Tasks with World Models
entries.description: Integrates state-space sequence models into R2I to improve long-term memory and credit assignment in imagination-based reinforcement learning.

entries.name: Improving Token-Based World Models with Parallel Observation Prediction
entries.fullTitle: Improving Token-Based World Models with Parallel Observation Prediction
entries.description: Introduces REM, a RetNet world model with parallel observation prediction to accelerate token-based imagination.

entries.name: THICK
entries.fullTitle: THICK
entries.description: Learns discrete latent context changes as adaptive temporal abstractions for hierarchical imagination, reinforcement learning, and planning.

entries.name: Hieros
entries.fullTitle: Hieros: Hierarchical Imagination on Structured State Space Sequence World Models
entries.description: Uses structured state-space dynamics and hierarchical latent imagination to learn policies at multiple temporal scales.

entries.name: PlaNet
entries.fullTitle: Learning Latent Dynamics for Planning from Pixels
entries.description: First RSSM; cross-entropy method planning in latent space

entries.name: Dreamer
entries.fullTitle: Dream to Control: Learning Behaviors by Latent Imagination
entries.description: Latent actor-critic; learn policy entirely in imagination

entries.name: DreamerV2
entries.fullTitle: Mastering Atari with Discrete World Models
entries.description: Discrete latents via categorical distributions

entries.name: DreamerV3
entries.fullTitle: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
entries.description: Single hyperparameter set; generalizes across 7 domains incl. Minecraft

entries.name: TD-MPC
entries.fullTitle: Temporal Difference Learning for Model Predictive Control
entries.description: Temporal-difference learning + MPC in latent space

entries.name: TD-MPC2
entries.fullTitle: TD-MPC2: Scalable, Robust World Models for Continuous Control
entries.description: Scales to 104 tasks; shared latent space

entries.name: TWM
entries.fullTitle: Transformer-based World Models Are Happy With 100k Interactions
entries.description: Uses Transformer-XL over latent states, actions, and rewards to generate imagined experience for sample-efficient Atari control.

entries.name: IRIS
entries.fullTitle: Transformers are Sample-Efficient World Models
entries.description: Tokenize frames with discrete autoencoders; GPT-based dynamics

entries.name: STORM
entries.fullTitle: STORM: Efficient Stochastic Transformer based World Models for Reinforcement Learning
entries.description: Efficient transformer-based latent dynamics

entries.name: DreamerPro
entries.fullTitle: DreamerPro: Reconstruction-Free Model-Based Reinforcement Learning with Prototypical Representations
entries.description: Prototypical self-supervised objectives for sparse-reward tasks

entries.name: Iso-Dream
entries.fullTitle: Iso-Dream: Isolating and Leveraging Noncontrollable Visual Dynamics in World Models
entries.description: Disentangles controllable from non-controllable dynamics

entries.name: Simulus (formerly M^3)
entries.fullTitle: Simulus: Combining Improvements in Sample-Efficient World Model Agents
entries.description: Combines modular tokenization, uncertainty-driven exploration, prioritized model replay, and distributional prediction in a sample-efficient world-model agent.

entries.name: LPWM
entries.fullTitle: Latent Particle World Models: Self-supervised Object-centric Stochastic Dynamics Modeling
entries.description: Latent particle world models for object-centric stochastic dynamics

entries.name: RLVR-World
entries.fullTitle: RLVR-World: Training World Models with Reinforcement Learning
entries.description: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for world-model training

entries.name: RLA-WM
entries.fullTitle: Learning Visual Feature-Based World Models via Residual Latent Action
entries.description: Residual latent action prediction in visual feature space

entries.name: TC-WM
entries.fullTitle: Back to Parsimonious Latents: Learning Task-Centric World Models from Visual Foundations
entries.description: Task-centric compact latents from visual foundation features

entries.name: LoopWM
entries.fullTitle: Looped World Models
entries.description: Parameter-shared looped transformer for adaptive latent rollout depth

entries.name: SMWM
entries.fullTitle: Sensorimotor World Models: Perception for Action via Inverse Dynamics
entries.description: Sensorimotor World Models: Perception for Action via Inverse Dynamics; inverse-dynamics-regularized latent representations for action-aligned, collapse-resistant states

entries.name: Task-Sufficient World Models
entries.fullTitle: Learning Task-Sufficient World Models by Synergizing Agentic Exploration and Structured Modeling
entries.description: Closed-loop agentic exploration and structured modeling for compact, task-sufficient latent states

entries.name: Operator-on-F
entries.fullTitle: Operator-on-F complements value-equivalence: a planning-time diagnostic for latent world models
entries.description: Planning-time latent pushforward diagnostic that complements reward/value prediction for model-based RL

entries.name: ATM
entries.fullTitle: ATM: Action-Consistency Transfer Matrix for Diagnosing and Improving Latent World Models
entries.description: Action-consistency transfer matrix for diagnosing and improving latent world models without expensive simulator rollouts

entries.name: DreamerV4
entries.fullTitle: Training Agents Inside of Scalable World Models
entries.description: Scalable shortcut-forcing transformer world model; agents trained purely in imagination from offline data (also in §3.1)

entries.name: C-SWM
entries.fullTitle: Contrastive Learning of Structured World Models
entries.description: Contrastive structured world models: object-factored latent states and GNN transitions without pixel reconstruction

entries.name: G-SWM
entries.fullTitle: Improving Generative Imagination in Object-Centric World Models
entries.description: Generative structured world model unifying object interaction, occlusion, multimodal uncertainty, and situation-aware imagination

entries.name: SAVi
entries.fullTitle: Conditional Object-Centric Learning from Video
entries.description: Conditional slot-attention on video; object-centric representations that track entities through time

entries.name: TransDreamer
entries.fullTitle: TransDreamer: Reinforcement Learning with Transformer World Models
entries.description: Replaces the RSSM recurrence with a transformer state-space model (TSSM) for imagination-based RL

entries.name: DayDreamer
entries.fullTitle: DayDreamer: World Models for Physical Robot Learning
entries.description: Dreamer trained directly on physical robots (quadruped walking in 1 hour) without simulators

entries.name: Masked World Models (MWM)
entries.fullTitle: Masked World Models for Visual Control
entries.description: Decouples visual representation (masked autoencoding) from dynamics learning for visual robotic control

entries.name: SlotFormer
entries.fullTitle: SlotFormer: Unsupervised Visual Dynamics Simulation with Object-Centric Models
entries.description: Transformer dynamics over slot representations for unsupervised object-centric visual simulation

entries.name: S4WM
entries.fullTitle: Facing Off World Model Backbones: RNNs, Transformers, and S4
entries.description: Systematic face-off of RNN, transformer, and S4 world-model backbones; S4-based world model for long-range memory

entries.name: HarmonyDream
entries.fullTitle: HarmonyDream: Task Harmonization Inside World Models
entries.description: Automatically harmonizes observation-modeling vs. reward-modeling losses inside world-model learning

entries.name: DUET-DINO
entries.fullTitle: DUET-DINO: Simultaneous Cross-View World Modeling for Latent Planning in Robot Manipulation
entries.description: Jointly predicts action-conditioned side- and wrist-camera representations for full 7-DoF latent planning, exploiting complementary scene and gripper views during manipulation.

entries.name: Semigroup-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Semigroup-JEPA: Latent Dynamics Consistency for Zero-Shot Physics Generalization
entries.description: Conditions latent dynamics on physical parameters and backpropagates multi-step rollout losses into the encoder to improve prediction and control under unseen gravitational regimes.

entries.name: Coupled Control and Wireless WMs
entries.fullTitle: Coupled Control and Wireless World Models for Resilient Remote Robotic Control
entries.description: Couples JEPA models of robot dynamics and wireless-channel evolution for predictive communication scheduling and adaptation under visual and radio disturbances.

entries.name: Physically Grounded JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Toward Physically Grounded JEPA World Models for Goal-Conditioned Robotic Planning
entries.description: Adds inverse dynamics and physical-state alignment to latent prediction, preserving action-relevant transitions and improving visually goal-conditioned robot planning.

entries.name: Spectral-Target Latent Structuring
entries.fullTitle: Spectral-Target Physical Latent Structuring for JEPA-Style World Models
entries.description: Adds a training-only Fourier auxiliary head to discourage physically uninformative JEPA representations and improve latent-space planning in dynamic and low-data settings.

entries.name: Point-Cloud JEPA Planning
entries.fullTitle: Does Latent Planning Survive Point Clouds? Action-Conditioned JEPA World Models for Geometric Observations
entries.description: Tests three action-conditioned JEPA designs on geometric observations and demonstrates latent planning, robustness to point dropout, and direct 3D target specification without goal images.

entries.name: Flow-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Flow-JEPA: Flow Matching for Robust Latent Dynamics in JEPA World Models
entries.description: Replaces deterministic one-step latent regression with conditional flow matching over future latent trajectories, improving goal-conditioned control robustness under visual noise.

entries.name: LeVJEPA
entries.fullTitle: LeVJEPA: Efficient & Scalable Video Pretraining without the Heuristics
entries.description: Extends LeJEPA-style regularization to efficient video representation pretraining with random token dropping and optional causal attention; an architectural foundation rather than an action-conditioned simulator.

entries.name: Successive Capacity Growth
entries.fullTitle: Successive Capacity Growth: Task-Complexity-Driven Width and Depth Expansion for Vision Transformer Encoders in JEPA World Models
entries.description: Expands JEPA encoder width or depth through function-preserving trials and prediction-loss checks, studying adaptive model capacity for navigation and multi-object dynamics.

entries.name: JEPA-x
entries.fullTitle: JEPA-x: Cross-Predictive Physics Grounding for Forecastable Latent Dynamics
entries.description: Cross-predicts visual and privileged physical-state trajectories through shared dynamics during training, grounding latent transitions while retaining vision-only deployment.

entries.name: LpWM
entries.fullTitle: LpWM: A Case for Sparse Representations in World Models
entries.description: Regularizes JEPA features toward nonnegative sparse distributions, reducing the predictor capacity needed for planning and separating discrete dynamical regimes from continuous within-regime state.

entries.name: Demo-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Demo-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for One-shot Cross-Embodiment Imitation
entries.description: Transforms cross-embodiment visual demonstrations into future latent subgoals for planning under the target robot's own dynamics.

entries.name: A Lightweight Library for Energy-Based Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures
entries.fullTitle: A Lightweight Library for Energy-Based Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures
entries.description: Provides modular JEPA implementations spanning image representation learning, temporal prediction, and action-conditioned planning.

entries.name: seq-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: seq-JEPA: Autoregressive Predictive Learning of Invariant-Equivariant World Models
entries.description: Autoregressively predicts transformed visual embeddings while separating invariant and equivariant representations.

entries.name: CheXWorld
entries.fullTitle: CheXWorld: Exploring Image World Modeling for Radiograph Representation Learning
entries.description: Applies predictive image-world-model pretraining to radiographs, modeling anatomy, layout, and appearance-domain transformations.

entries.name: EgoAgent
entries.fullTitle: EgoAgent: A Joint Predictive Agent Model in Egocentric Worlds
entries.description: Jointly learns egocentric representations, future states, and actions with a temporally asymmetric predictive architecture.

entries.name: Learning and Leveraging World Models in Visual Representation Learning
entries.fullTitle: Learning and Leveraging World Models in Visual Representation Learning
entries.description: Extends JEPA to predict photometric transformations in latent space and studies controllable invariance and equivariance in learned representations.

entries.name: Temporal-Distance JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Temporal-Distance JEPA: Plan-Aware Representation Learning for Latent World Model Predictive Control
entries.description: Learns a directed temporal-progress cost from reward-free trajectories and aligns representation learning with the multi-step ranking requirements of latent model-predictive control.

entries.name: Controlled World Model Identifiability
entries.fullTitle: On the Identifiability of Controlled World Models
entries.description: Establishes joint representation and transition identifiability conditions under which LeJEPA-style predictive objectives recover latent states and controlled dynamics up to an orthogonal transformation.

entries.name: I-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Self-Supervised Learning from Images with a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture
entries.description: Predicts context representations of masked image patches; strong linear-probe performance without pixel decoding.

entries.name: V-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Revisiting Feature Prediction for Learning Visual Representations from Video
entries.description: Learns video representations by predicting masked spatiotemporal features in latent space, providing a predictive representation backbone for downstream visual understanding.

entries.name: V-JEPA 2
entries.fullTitle: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning
entries.description: Milestone. Pretrains on >1M hours of video, enables zero-shot robotic manipulation via latent action-conditioned planning with <62h robot video.

entries.name: V-JEPA 2.1
entries.fullTitle: V-JEPA 2.1: Unlocking Dense Features in Video Self-Supervised Learning
entries.description: Updates V-JEPA with denser video features, improving its usefulness as a predictive representation backbone.

entries.name: LeWorldModel / LeWM
entries.fullTitle: LeWorldModel: Stable End-to-End Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture from Pixels
entries.description: Stable end-to-end JEPA world model from raw pixels with action-conditioned latent prediction, fast planning, and compact single-GPU training.

entries.name: Fast LeWorldModel
entries.fullTitle: Fast LeWorldModel
entries.description: Replaces autoregressive one-step LeWM rollouts with parallel action-prefix latent prediction, reducing planning latency and long-horizon error accumulation.

entries.name: SkyJEPA
entries.fullTitle: SkyJEPA: Learning Long-Horizon World Models for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Control of Quadrotors
entries.description: JEPA-style latent dynamics model for real-time quadrotor control, pairing physically interpretable probing with sampling-based optimal control for zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

entries.name: AdaJEPA
entries.fullTitle: AdaJEPA: An Adaptive Latent World Model
entries.description: Adapts latent dynamics online during model-predictive control, using observed transitions as self-supervision for changing environments.

entries.name: Delta-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Delta-JEPA: Learning Action-Sensitive World Models via Latent Difference Decoding
entries.description: Decodes action-sensitive latent differences to make the predictive representation reflect controllable state changes rather than action-insensitive dynamics.

entries.name: Qantara
entries.fullTitle: Qantara: Bridge-Flow Training for Multi-Paradigm JEPA Control
entries.description: Trains one JEPA checkpoint to support latent planning, behavior cloning, and inverse dynamics through bridge-flow objectives.

entries.name: FF-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: FF-JEPA: Long-Horizon Planning in World Models with Latent Planners
entries.description: Adds an action-free latent planner on top of JEPA dynamics to decompose long-horizon planning without requiring an explicit goal image.

entries.name: Branch-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Branch-JEPA: Finite-Support Predictive Distributions for JEPA World Models
entries.description: Represents each transition as a weighted finite set of latent successors, retaining all branches at inference and supporting both specialization and full-set Energy-Score training for stochastic futures.

entries.name: LeJEPA Theory
entries.fullTitle: When Does LeJEPA Learn a World Model?
entries.description: Provides identifiability conditions under which JEPA-style embeddings recover latent world variables useful for planning.

entries.name: JEPA Generalization Theory
entries.fullTitle: A Generalization Theory for JEPA-Based World Models
entries.description: Connects JEPA pretraining error to downstream planning regret through a finite-sample generalization analysis of action-conditioned latent prediction.

entries.name: V-JEPA Learns Intuitive Physics
entries.fullTitle: Intuitive physics understanding emerges from self-supervised pretraining on natural videos
entries.description: Evidence that JEPA-style video pretraining can induce physical prediction useful for world modeling.

entries.name: DINO-World
entries.fullTitle: Back to the Features: DINO as a Foundation for Video World Models
entries.description: Shows that strong pretrained visual features can serve as the foundation for video world modeling.

entries.name: DINO-Foresight
entries.fullTitle: DINO-Foresight: Looking into the Future with DINO
entries.description: Predicts future DINO/VFM feature trajectories for autonomous-driving scene understanding, avoiding pixel-level rollout cost while keeping downstream heads usable.

entries.name: MC-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: MC-JEPA: A Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Self-Supervised Learning of Motion and Content Features

entries.name: A-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: A-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture Can Listen
entries.description: Predicts masked audio-spectrogram representations with time-frequency-aware masking for self-supervised audio learning.

entries.name: Hierarchical JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Hierarchical World Models as Visual Whole-Body Humanoid Controllers
entries.description: Multi-level JEPA world models controlling full humanoid body; imagination-based whole-body planning.

entries.name: LeJEPA
entries.fullTitle: LeJEPA: Provable and Scalable Self-Supervised Learning Without the Heuristics
entries.description: The original LeJEPA paper (referenced by several §2.2 entries but missing itself). Proves the isotropic Gaussian is the optimal JEPA embedding distribution and enforces it with SIGReg, removing stop-gradients, teacher-student EMA, and schedulers.

entries.name: PSG-JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Is Forward Prediction Enough? Physical State Grounding for JEPA World Models
entries.description: Adds training-only grounding objectives that tie individual latents to robot proprioceptive state and latent pairs to multi-horizon joint-angle changes, improving probing, latent planning, and policy learning.

entries.name: AC-MTM
entries.fullTitle: No Gaussian Required: Contrastive Inverse Dynamics for JEPA World Models
entries.description: Replaces LeWM's SIGReg anti-collapse regularizer with a training-only Action-NCE inverse-dynamics head; a collapsed encoder provably fails the action-discrimination task, so no prescribed embedding geometry is needed.

entries.name: Orthogonal JEPA
entries.fullTitle: Orthogonal JEPA: Factorized Predictive States for Latent World Models
entries.description: Replaces the monolithic JEPA target with orthogonally factorized predictive components synthesized back into a full latent state, evaluated across vision, control, health records, and molecular dynamics.

entries.name: Navigation-Guided Sparse Scene Representation for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
entries.fullTitle: Navigation-Guided Sparse Scene Representation for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
entries.description: Uses sparse navigation-guided scene tokens and self-supervised future-scene alignment for efficient end-to-end driving.

entries.name: CarFormer
entries.fullTitle: CarFormer: Self-Driving with Learned Object-Centric Representations
entries.description: Learns object-centric BEV slots for driving and predicts their future evolution with a transformer world model.

entries.name: Enhancing End-to-End Autonomous Driving with Latent World Model
entries.fullTitle: Enhancing End-to-End Autonomous Driving with Latent World Model
entries.description: Predicts future driving-scene features conditioned on ego trajectories as self-supervision for end-to-end planning.

entries.name: DriveWorld
entries.fullTitle: DriveWorld: 4D Pre-trained Scene Understanding via World Models for Autonomous Driving
entries.description: Pretrains driving representations with dynamic memory for future-state prediction and static scene propagation for spatial context.

entries.name: BEVWorld
entries.fullTitle: BEVWorld: A Multimodal World Simulator for Autonomous Driving via Scene-Level BEV Latents

entries.name: OccSora
entries.fullTitle: OccSora: 4D Occupancy Generation Models as World Simulators for Autonomous Driving

entries.name: Think2Drive
entries.fullTitle: Think2Drive: Efficient Reinforcement Learning by Thinking in Latent World Model for Quasi-Realistic Autonomous Driving (in CARLA-v2)

entries.name: HoloDrive
entries.fullTitle: HoloDrive: Holistic 2D-3D Multi-Modal Street Scene Generation for Autonomous Driving
entries.description: Jointly generates camera images and LiDAR point clouds and extends the multimodal model to predict future driving states.

entries.name: Enhancing Physical Consistency
entries.fullTitle: Enhancing Physical Consistency in Lightweight World Models

entries.name: Unified Driving Tokens
entries.fullTitle: Unified Driving Tokens: Representation- and Geometry-Guided Discrete Tokenizer for Driving World Models and Planning
entries.description: Builds a driving-specific tokenizer that preserves geometric and planning-relevant information for token-based world modeling.

entries.name: Tesla Occupancy Networks
entries.fullTitle: Occupancy Networks
entries.description: Primary technical material on Tesla's production occupancy networks: multi-camera volumetric occupancy plus occupancy flow prediction for general obstacle avoidance (non-arXiv industry source; expanded at Tesla AI Day 2022).
entries.venue: Tesla, CVPR 2022 Workshop on Autonomous Driving keynote

entries.name: Differentiable Raycasting for Self-Supervised Occupancy Forecasting
entries.fullTitle: Differentiable Raycasting for Self-supervised Occupancy Forecasting
entries.description: Learns ego-conditioned freespace/occupancy forecasting from raw LiDAR sweeps via differentiable raycasting, letting occupancy emerge without labels.

entries.name: MILE
entries.fullTitle: Model-Based Imitation Learning for Urban Driving
entries.description: Jointly learns compact visual dynamics and a driving policy from offline demonstrations, enabling action sequences predicted in imagination.

entries.name: Point Cloud Forecasting as a Proxy for 4D Occupancy Forecasting
entries.fullTitle: Point Cloud Forecasting as a Proxy for 4D Occupancy Forecasting
entries.description: Forecasts a 4D spacetime occupancy field and renders point clouds from it, factoring sensor extrinsics out of self-supervised world modeling; basis of the CVPR Argoverse occupancy forecasting challenge (already listed under Workshops).

entries.name: StreamingFlow
entries.fullTitle: StreamingFlow: Streaming Occupancy Forecasting with Asynchronous Multi-modal Data Streams via Neural Ordinary Differential Equation
entries.description: Neural-ODE BEV state evolution that forecasts occupancy continuously in time from asynchronous camera and LiDAR streams.

entries.name: Cam4DOcc
entries.fullTitle: Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D Occupancy Forecasting in Autonomous Driving Applications
entries.description: Standard benchmark and baselines for forecasting how 3D occupancy evolves from camera input only (could alternatively be routed to Benchmarks & Evaluation).

entries.name: UnO
entries.fullTitle: UnO: Unsupervised Occupancy Fields for Perception and Forecasting
entries.description: Continuous 4D occupancy field learned unsupervised from LiDAR, unifying perception and forecasting of the world state without object labels.

entries.name: UniOcc
entries.fullTitle: UniOcc: A Unified Benchmark for Occupancy Forecasting and Prediction in Autonomous Driving
entries.description: Unifies nuScenes, Waymo, CARLA, and OpenCOOD occupancy data with flow annotations for cross-dataset occupancy forecasting (could alternatively be routed to Benchmarks & Evaluation).

entries.name: GASP
entries.fullTitle: GASP: Unifying Geometric and Semantic Self-Supervised Pre-training for Autonomous Driving
entries.description: Self-supervised 4D pretraining that predicts continuous spacetime occupancy, ego paths, and distilled foundation-model features as a unified geometric-semantic world representation.

entries.name: RoboOccWorld
entries.fullTitle: Occupancy World Model for Robots
entries.description: Extends occupancy world modeling from outdoor driving grids to indoor embodied scenes with local-observation-conditioned forecasting.

entries.name: DynaDreamer
entries.fullTitle: Ego-Dynamics-Augmented World Model for Autonomous Driving with Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment Adaptation
entries.description: Disentangles ego-motion from scene dynamics in BEV latent world models, freeing capacity for scene modeling and enabling zero-shot transfer across vehicle chassis.

entries.name: LPA-CWM
entries.fullTitle: LPA-CWM: A Learned Physical Adjudicator for Motion Reasoning with Counterfactual World Models
entries.description: Learns reliability weights over factual and intervened video-prediction responses to recover motion, with completeness-aware evaluation of correspondence and tracking.

entries.description: Learns discriminative dynamics over object and attribute abstractions for exploration, transfer, and long-horizon planning.
